by ANDREEVICH VONSIATSKY

FIVE men sit in the semi-darkness of a dank and filthy cellar room in a town in northern Russia. They speak in subdued whispers for spoken words mean sudden and brutal death. A paper lies in front of them. They scan it with feverish eyes.
“Soon, very soon,” one whispers, “the day of glory will arrive.”
In other cities in Russia other men scan a paper with the same contents and they, too, speak only in whispers. In Paris, Warsaw, in Buenos Aires—in every part of the world other men read the same paper and take hope.
In the United States in a charming Colonial farm house, located on the Thompson-Providence Cut-off Road, within a few miles of the village of Thompson, Connecticut, a man sits alone before a desk in an underground room. He is tall and powerfully built; his eyes are dark and filled with a sombre sadness.
The room is brilliantly lighted. The furniture is plain but expensive. On the walls are a few pictures and over the desk is an excellent painting of the late Czar of all the Russias. On the wall at the right of the man at the desk, in a glass case is a faded Russian uniform with bullet holes still visible in it.
Slowly and with deft fingers this man sorts the papers on his desk, and as he does, his fingers are touching threads that spread to all parts of the world—to the smoke filled cellar room in northern Russia where silent men plot death and revolution in subdued whispers.
A strange man is this sombre-eyed giant that sits alone at this desk in the basement of the century-old Connecticut farmhouse. He is the center of a net of intrigue and plotting that someday may overthrow one of the most powerful governments in the world—Soviet Russia.

Yet the most amazing thing about his story is the Colonial house he had chosen for his headquarters. It is Carolyn Hall, the country estate of the late Norman B. Reams, famous steel baron.
For over a hundred years this famous old house has been the home of wealthy, conservative and quiet-living families. The spacious lawns that slope gracefully into the green-covered hills of the country-side are pastoral and mellow and peaceful.
Fifteen years ago this house jumped into the headlines with a society story that rocked the two continents. Marion Stevens Reams, daughter of Norman B. Reams and heiress to a forty-million dollar fortune, astounded the world by announcing her marriage to Anatase Andreevitch Vonsiatsky, a White Russian refugee she had met in Paris.
After that Carolyn Hall underwent a strange change. Beneath the shiny white clapboards were constructed thick and impenetrable walls, the walls of a fort. The glass in the windows was made bullet-proof. The white picket fence that surrounds the place was wired with powerful electric alarms, and behind this picket fence savage wolf-hounds lie in wait to tear any unwelcome visitor to pieces.
For over this old Colonial home lies the grim and stark shadow of brutal and sudden death. A room in the cellar is an arsenal where rifles, ammunition, revolvers are stored. In other rooms young recruits, trained daily as soldiers, wait, ready to spring forth with their rifles at the first sign of danger.
Sometimes Andreevitch Vonsiatsky walks out on the spacious lawns, but when he does, he wears a bullet-proof vest, and his faithful wolfhounds follow him and sentinels placed in important parts of the house scan the country-side.
For Andreevitch Vonsiatsky is the head of the White Russian Organization to overthrow the Soviet. He has made Carolyn Hall the headquarters of the vast network of intrigue and plot-

作者：安德烈耶维奇·冯夏茨基（ANDREEVICH VONSIATSKY）

五个人坐在俄罗斯北部某城镇一间潮湿肮脏的地下室里，四周半明半暗。他们压低声音耳语，因为高声说话意味着突然而残酷的死亡。一张纸摆在他们面前。他们用狂热的目光审视着它。
“很快，非常很快，”其中一人低声说道，“荣耀之日即将来临。”

在俄罗斯的其他城市，其他人也在审阅着内容相同的文件，他们也只敢低声交谈。在巴黎、华沙、布宜诺斯艾利斯——在世界各地的其他地方，人们阅读着同样的文件，并从中获得希望。

在美国，康涅狄格州汤普森村附近几英里处的汤普森-普罗维登斯捷径公路旁，坐落着一栋迷人的殖民时期农舍。在一间地下室内，一名男子独自坐在书桌前。他身材高大，体格魁梧；双眼深邃，充满忧郁的悲伤。

房间里灯火通明。家具朴素但昂贵。墙上挂着几幅画，书桌上方悬挂着一幅精美的已故全俄罗斯沙皇的肖像画。在书桌右侧的墙上，一个玻璃柜中陈列着一件褪色的俄军制服，上面仍清晰可见弹孔。

这名男子用灵巧的手指慢慢整理着桌上的文件，与此同时，他的手指正触碰着延伸至世界各地的线索——通向俄罗斯北部那间烟雾弥漫的地下室，那里沉默的人们正压低声音策划着死亡与革命。

这位独自坐在百年历史的康涅狄格州农舍地下室书桌前的阴郁巨人是个奇特的人物。他是一个阴谋与策划网络的中心，这个网络有朝一日可能会推翻世界上最强大的政府之一——苏维埃俄国。

然而，关于他的故事最令人惊讶的是他选作总部的殖民时期房屋。那是卡罗琳厅（Carolyn Hall），已故著名钢铁大亨诺曼·B·里姆斯（Norman B. Reams）的乡村庄园。

一百多年来，这座著名的老宅一直是富裕、保守且生活宁静的家庭的住所。缓缓倾斜至乡间翠绿山丘的宽阔草坪呈现出田园般柔和宁静的景象。

十五年前，这所房子因一则轰动两大洲的社会新闻而登上头条。诺曼·B·里姆斯的女儿、拥有四千万美元遗产的继承人马里恩·史蒂文斯·里姆斯（Marion Stevens Reams）宣布嫁给她在巴黎结识的白色俄罗斯难民阿纳斯塔斯·安德烈耶维奇·冯夏茨基（Anatase Andreevitch Vonsiatsky），令世界震惊。

此后，卡罗琳厅发生了奇异的变化。在光亮的白色护墙板之下，建造了厚实且坚不可摧的墙壁，宛如堡垒之墙。窗户上的玻璃被换成了防弹玻璃。环绕此地的白色尖桩篱笆通上了强力电子警报器，而在这些尖桩篱笆后面，凶猛的狼犬潜伏着，随时准备将任何不速之客撕成碎片。

因为在这座古老的殖民时期住宅之上，笼罩着残酷而突然死亡的严峻阴影。地下室的一个房间是军火库，储存着步枪、弹药和左轮手枪。在其他房间里，每天像士兵一样受训的年轻 recruits 等待着，一旦有危险迹象，便准备好持枪冲出。

有时，安德烈耶维奇·冯夏茨基会走到宽阔的草坪上，但每当此时，他都穿着防弹背心，忠实的狼犬跟随其后，部署在房屋重要位置的哨兵则监视着乡间。

因为安德烈耶维奇·冯夏茨基是旨在推翻苏维埃政权的白色俄罗斯组织的首领。他已将卡罗琳厅定为庞大阴谋与策划网络的总部——

blurred and dazed mem-
ory of street-fights and

It was the first night of the
Red Revolution.

It came suddenly, almost without
warning. I was a student in the Em-

was a marked man, as were all my
comrades in the academy. We were a
part of the old system of the Czar.
A few of us escaped. Of that escape
I can remember but few details. We

We fled over rough country roads and
when morning came we slept in an
old barn, our brains seared with
that terrifying picture of a nation
revolting.
The Revolution, in those first days,

我的故事始于
模糊而恍惚的记忆，
充满了街头斗殴和
疯狂的警报；到处是
燃烧的建筑物，人们头顶
挥舞着冒烟的火把，
从那毁灭的大浩劫中
从黑暗里冲出来。
那是红色革命的第一夜。

它来得突然，几乎毫无
预兆。我是尼古拉皇帝军事学院
的一名学生。我和学院里的所有同
学一样，都是被标记的目标。我们是
沙皇旧制度的一部分。
我们中有几个人逃脱了。对于那次逃
跑，我只记得很少的细节。我们在夜间
逃离圣彼得堡。
我们崎岖的乡间道路上奔逃，
当早晨来临时，我们睡在一个
旧谷仓里，脑海中烙刻着
一个国家起义的那幅恐怖景象。
在最初的那些日子里，
革命尚未蔓延到乡村地
区，我们在夜间行进，向农民乞讨
一点食物，像他们一样吃黑面包、
喝酸牛奶。我们只有一个地方可去。
那就是新切尔卡斯克（Novocherkassk），
阿列克谢耶夫将军（General Alexieff）在那里指挥正在集
结的白色俄罗斯军队，那里也是
将要领导白色俄罗斯的军官们的
训练学校。
安德烈耶维奇·冯夏茨基的故事
是一个惊人的故事，他第一次讲述
了这座“死亡之屋”背后的真实故事，
这所房子曾引发两次国会调查，
并带来了令人困惑的神秘色彩。
在向读者提供这个故事时，
《True》杂志不对其中表达的政治
信念承担责任，因为这些是冯夏茨基
的政治信条。这个故事是关于高度
冒险和奇异阴谋的叙述。其趣味性和
历史重要性是其存在的理由——而非
宣传或成功的可能性。因为冯夏茨基
是舞台上一个独特的人物……

published by the local group of Vonsiatsky's "All-

OUR RELATIONS WITH FASCISTS OF OTHER COUNTRIES.

Referring to an article which appeared in the local
Russian newspaper "SLOVO" on 26-8-39 on the subject of arrival in
Shanghai of Messrs. Chotaro Fukuda and Eno Tsunematsu, represen-
tatives of the Japanese Fascist Party, the "Russian Vanguard" in
the issue dated 3-9-39 writes:-

"The exchange of visits between representatives of Russian
and Japanese Fascists is quite a normal proceeding for, believing
in the same principles and ideas, we cannot but have mutual respect
and sympathies.

Mr. Fukuda's visit of our Centre was a manifestation of
this spirit of friendship. Of course, our Centre can also be
useful to Japanese Fascists, as we know better than anybody else
the common enemy of all Fascists - the Third International - and
their methods. Our advice in the matter of struggle against the
Red Beast cannot be without a value to anyone who is engaged in
such a struggle.

But neither we nor Japanese Fascists can go any farther.
Irrespective of how great our mutual sympathies may be, we will
not even think of adopting any common decisions during the course
of our friendly meetings and conversations, as neither we nor they
have any power of directing the course of events in our respective
countries. We cannot adopt any decisions, we even cannot promise
anything to each other. Owing to circumstances over which we have
no control, we, at any moment, may find ourselves in two opposing
camps. We shall respect each other as ever, but we shall fight
with determination, as each party will fight for its own country.

Therefore, anyone who, having seen the "Slovo's" article
referred to above, decides that we have come to an agreement with
the Japanese Fascists and thus adopted a pro-Japanese attitude will
be entirely wrong.

In the same way as Japanese Fascists can only be pro-
Japanese in their attitude, our attitude can be only pro-Russian.

我们要与其他国家法西斯分子的关系。

提及8月26日当地俄文报纸《言论报》（"SLOVO"）上刊登的一篇关于日本法西斯党代表福田长太郎（Chotaro Fukuda）和恒松英野（Eno Tsunematsu）先生抵达上海的文章，《俄罗斯先锋报》在9月3日的一期中写道：

“俄罗斯和日本法西斯代表之间的互访是完全正常的程序，因为信奉相同的原则和理念，我们不得不相互尊重和同情。

福田先生访问我们的中心正是这种友谊精神的体现。当然，我们的中心对日本法西斯分子也有用处，因为我们比任何人都更了解所有法西斯分子的共同敌人——第三国际——及其手段。我们在对抗红色野兽斗争方面的建议，对任何从事此类斗争的人来说都不会没有价值。

但是，我们和日本法西斯分子都不能走得更远。无论我们的相互同情多么强烈，在我们友好的会晤和谈话过程中，我们甚至不会考虑通过任何共同决定，因为我们和他们都没有权力指导各自国家的事态发展。我们不能通过任何决定，甚至不能向对方做出任何承诺。由于我们无法控制的情况，我们随时可能发现自己处于两个对立的阵营中。我们将一如既往地相互尊重，但我们将坚决战斗，因为各方都将为自己的国家而战。

因此，任何看到上述《言论报》文章就断定我们与日本法西斯分子达成了协议并因此采取了亲日态度的人，都是完全错误的。

正如日本法西斯分子在其态度上只能是亲日的一样，我们的态度也只能是亲俄的。

There are in the Far East organizations which call
themselves Russian Fascists, but in their activities are guided
by foreign interests often excluding the interests of Russia.
Of course, from our viewpoint, these groups only disguise them-
selves as Russian Fascists. However, they are generally known
under this name and therefore true Fascists are sometimes held
responsible for their activities.

Our relations with foreign Fascists are quite different.
We are building up the Russian national cause with Russian hands
only, and do not subordinate this cause to any foreign direction.
Therefore, the exchange of visits which took place between the
Japanese and Russian Fascists should be regarded solely as an act
of courtesy and friendship among the partisans of one and the
same ideology, and not as an event which may influence the
activities of our party. We have been and will be independent
from any foreign influence. Let this be known to our friends and
enemies as well."

在远东，有一些组织自称为俄罗斯法西斯主义者，但其活动受外国利益驱使，往往排斥俄罗斯的利益。当然，从我们的观点来看，这些团体只是伪装成俄罗斯法西斯主义者。然而，他们通常以此名称为人所知，因此真正的法西斯主义者有时需为他们的活动承担责任。

我们与外国法西斯主义者的关系截然不同。我们仅凭俄罗斯人的力量建立俄罗斯民族事业，不使这一事业屈从于任何外国的指挥。因此，日本法西斯主义者与俄罗斯法西斯主义者之间的互访，应仅仅被视为具有相同意识形态的支持者之间的一种礼貌和友好举动，而不应视为可能影响我们党活动的事件。我们过去独立于任何外国影响，将来也将如此。让我们的朋友和敌人都知道这一点。”

由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）撰写    经由 C. Gasfa. J.J. 转呈

1939年8月27日，由“全俄国家革命法西斯党”（领袖——A.A. 冯夏茨基，美国康涅狄格州普特南）当地小组出版的周刊《俄罗斯先锋报》上刊登了如下笔记：

日本法西斯主义领袖访问
全俄国家革命法西斯党远东中心总部。

1939年8月23日，近期抵达上海的日本法西斯主义领袖福田先生及其政党当地分支负责人拜访了全俄国家革命法西斯党远东中心负责人战斗员 K. 斯特克洛夫（K. Stekloff）。他们代表日本法西斯主义者向他致意，并祝愿由战斗员 A.A. 冯夏茨基领导的俄罗斯法西斯主义者取得一切成功。

随后，日本法西斯主义领袖为全俄国家革命法西斯党（A.R.N.R.F. Party）的代表举行了宴会，期间福田先生发表演讲，表达了对俄罗斯法西斯主义者及其领袖战斗员冯夏茨基的热情同情，并希望法西斯世界相互理解和兄弟般团结的时刻正在临近。

记者 N. 格罗辛（N. Grosin）先生向日本法西斯主义领袖赠送了他的题为《卡其色衬衫》的书，并递交了一本该书副本，请其转交给东京的荒木大将。

福多太郎（Chotaro Fukuda），35岁，出身于古老的武士家族，是一位以杰出服役而闻名的将军之子。1932年，他毕业于东京早稻田大学法学院，此后投身政治活动，并加入了新成立的日本法西斯党。凭借其非凡的才能，他迅速从普通党员晋升为该党公认的领袖。最近决定在中国设立该党的永久中心，总部设在上海。恩诺

newspaper "Russian Vanguard" on 23-4-39. Published by the

Member of the Communist Youth League resorts to threats.

FAKELOFF-RODZAEVSKY, former member of the Communist
Youth League at Blagoveschensk who has retained his connections
with the GPU despite his service in the Japanese Gendarmerie at
Harbin, disgraces the name of Russian Fascisti by his oppression
of the Russian population in Harbin. Having taken an extra dose
of heroin he took the liberty of uttering threats in his red-&
yellow sheet "NATION" of 1-4-39 (No.10 ) against certain per-
sons who attended the reception held at the Park Hotel on
17-2-39 on the occasion of the arrival in Shanghai of A.A. VON-
SIATSKY,the true leader of Russian Fascisti.
        RODZAEVSKY recommends to "retain in memory"the names
                    c/
of certain guests,including even ladies! It will not be diffi-
cult to follow his advice: some of the persons mentioned by him,
for instance, Colonel STEKLOFF are fairly well known and will
be remembered oy both their friends and enemies.
        But what of this? These persons are openly at war
    the
with communists and with those who harm Russia or intend to do
so when opportunity arises. They are not children and understand
that war is war, so that to threaten them means wasting time
and words: they know well that if the GPU get hold of them they
cannot expect mercy; that should the entire Asia from the Paci-
fic coast to the Ural mountains become a "-kuo" of some sort
in accordance with the dreams of RODZAEVSKY & Co. and their mas-
ters,many members of the ALL-RUSSIA NATIONAL REVOLUTIONARY FAS-
CIST PARTY will suffer at the hands of RODZAEVSKY & Co various
tortures,such as pouring kerosine oil into one's nose and other
kinds of torture practised by these gentlemen ( or comrades,to
use the more correct name ) wherever and whenever possible.
        This will not surprise us,as we know with whom we are
dealing. The question is whether or not RODZAEVSKY & Co will have

1939年4月23日俄文周刊《俄罗斯先锋报》上发表的文章译文。由俄罗斯先锋出版公司出版，地址：静安寺路749号207室。编辑——K.A. 斯特克洛夫先生。

共青团员诉诸威胁。

FAKELOFF-RODZAEVSKY，前布拉戈维申斯克共青团员，尽管在哈尔滨的日本宪兵队服役，但仍保持与国家政治保卫总局（GPU）的联系，他通过压迫哈尔滨的俄罗斯居民，玷污了俄罗斯法西斯主义者的名声。在额外服用了一剂海洛因后，他在1939年4月1日的红黄小报《民族报》（第10期）中肆意威胁某些参加了1939年2月17日为庆祝真正的俄罗斯法西斯主义者领袖 A.A. 冯夏茨基抵达上海而在国际饭店举行的招待会的人士。
        罗扎耶夫斯基建议“记住”某些客人的名字，甚至包括女士！遵循他的建议并不难：他提到的一些人，例如斯特克洛夫上校，相当知名，会被他们的朋友和敌人记住。
        但这又如何呢？这些人公开与共产主义者以及那些伤害俄罗斯或伺机伤害俄罗斯的人处于战争状态。他们不是孩子，明白战争就是战争，因此威胁他们意味着浪费时间和言语：他们很清楚，如果被国家政治保卫总局抓住，就别指望得到宽恕；如果按照罗扎耶夫斯基及其同伙和他们的主人的梦想，整个亚洲从太平洋沿岸到乌拉尔山脉变成某种形式的“-国”（kuo），那么许多全俄国家革命法西斯党的成员将在罗扎耶夫斯基及其同伙手中遭受各种酷刑，例如往鼻子里灌煤油，以及这些绅士们（或者用更正确的称呼，同志们）在任何可能的地方和时间实施的其他种类的酷刑。
        这不会让我们感到惊讶，因为我们知道我们在与谁打交道。问题在于罗扎耶夫斯基及其同伙是否会

time to carry their threats into effect. Clouds are already ga-
thering on the horizon, and when the storm breaks out, it will
either destroy the entire modern civilization or wipe out the
Soviet regime in Russia. In the first case everything will be
destroyed even without the assistance of RODZAEVSKY & Co by the
human beasts run amuck. In the second case RODZAEVSKY & Co will
have to think fast where to hide themselves. For their names
will be remembered by Russians even without any advice on our
part: those who saw them in Harbin and other places where they
exist will loath them for ever!
One thing is certain: they will not dare to make their
appearance in Russia unless she is called the U.S.S.R. or a "-kuo"
of some sort.
We will wait and see! For the time being we can only
say : "do not take the trouble of threatening us, comrade RODZAEV-
SKY! We know very well without your warnings that you are ca-
pable of any provocation, any treachery; we know very well to
whom you are serving and why - it is an open secret. No attack
on your part including kidnappings after the Paris style will
suprise us. And you yourself would only be ridiculous , but for
the disgust your life - equally base whether political or private-
arouses in us.
We know that being a member of the "anti-communist"
organization protected by the Japanese gendarmerie you frequent-
ly send your "honourable" mother as a courier between you and
the GPU.
In your private life you also acted as member of the
Communist Youth League when you threw on the street your wife
and child in order to be able to take another woman. Then how
can one take people like you seriously as public workers, espe-
cially if one knows that you are a cocaine and heroin addict?
As to the fact that you can bite, well, what of that? a snake
would also bite if it can creep near enough, or if one comes
too near to it!"
What else can we reply to people like RODZAEVSKY?

时间去将他们的威胁付诸实施。地平线上已乌云密布，当风暴爆发时，它要么摧毁整个现代文明，要么抹去俄罗斯的苏维埃政权。在第一种情况下，即使没有 RODZAEVSKY 及其同伙的协助，一切也将被那些横冲直撞的人面兽心之徒所毁灭。在第二种情况下，RODZAEVSKY 及其同伙必须迅速考虑藏身之处。因为即使没有我们的任何提示，俄罗斯人也会记住他们的名字：那些在哈尔滨及其他他们存在的地方见过他们的人将永远憎恶他们！
有一点是肯定的：除非俄罗斯被称为苏联（U.S.S.R.）或某种“-国”（-kuo），否则他们不敢在俄罗斯露面。
我们将拭目以待！目前我们只能说：“罗扎耶夫斯基同志，不必费心威胁我们！无需你的警告，我们就很清楚你能够进行任何挑衅、任何背叛；我们非常清楚你在为谁服务以及为何服务——这是一个公开的秘密。你方面的任何攻击，包括巴黎式的绑架，都不会让我们感到惊讶。而你自己只会显得可笑，如果不是因为你那无论是政治生活还是私生活都同样卑鄙的人生令我们感到厌恶的话。
我们知道，作为受日本宪兵队保护的“反共”组织成员，你经常派你那“可敬的”母亲在你和格别乌（GPU）之间充当信使。
在你的私人生活中，当你为了能够另娶一个女人而将妻儿抛弃街头时，你也曾作为共青团成员行事。那么，如果人们知道你是一个可卡因和海洛因成瘾者，又怎能把你这样的人视为严肃的公职人员呢？
至于你会咬人这一事实，那又怎样？如果蛇能爬得足够近，或者有人靠它太近，蛇也会咬人！”
对于像罗扎耶夫斯基这样的人，我们还能回答什么呢？

Perhaps we might tell him not to attempt to support his crook-
ed tricks by misquoting documents. We need not go far for an
example: in his sheet "NATION" of 1-4-39 it is stated that Bi-
shop John of Shanghai is one of the friends of RODZAEVSKY's or-
ganization. Asked if this was true, the Bishop categorically
denied this statement as well as any possibility of having any-
thing in common with a member of the Communist Youth League!
Furthermore, it is mentioned in the same sheet that General GIL-
BOFF and Colonel SIDOMANIDZE are among those who are threatened
because they attended the reception at the Park Hotel. As a
proof No. 153 of the "RUSSIAN VANGUARD" is mentioned. In reali-
ty, however, these persons were not among those present at the re-
ception and ,of course, were not mentioned in the list of guests
published in the "RUSSIAN VANGUARD".

We understand that comrade RODZAEVSKY, having taken
an extra dose of cocaine, would like to settle his accounts
with these persons who at one time disagreed with "Ataman" SE-
it
MENOFF, but would not be more clever on his part to do it with-
put misquoting the "RUSSIAN VANGUARD"?

Yes, comrade RODZAEVSKY, or ROZAOSUKU SAN ( as you
like the latter name better ) you have to be very careful in
playing your difficult part of sitting between two chairs.
Don't you know how your masters on either side of the frontier
treat their awkward servants? Remember, for instance, the fate
of one of them whom you knew well, the "Jerusalem cossack"(1)
who served to "Ataman" SEMENOFF, to the bolsheviks and to the
foreign power in whose service you are now! And he was not the
only one who was bumped off!

So that it is hard to say whose position is the more
dangerous one - yours or ours.

We will wait and see, And for the time being we will
put a fullstop.

Note (1) A Russian Jew SLOUTSKY, one of Ataman Semenoff's entou-
rage, who is reported to been "liquidated" by the Japanese in
December, 1938 on suspicion of being a Soviet agent?

-3-
也许我们可以告诉他，不要试图通过歪曲引用来支持他的欺诈伎俩。我们不需要远求例子：在他 1939 年 4 月 1 日的《民族报》（NATION）中称，上海的主教约翰（Bishop John）是罗扎耶夫斯基组织的朋友之一。当被问及这是否属实时，主教断然否认了这一说法，并否认与共青团成员有任何共同点的可能性！
此外，同一份报纸还提到，吉尔博夫将军（General GILBOFF）和西多马尼泽上校（Colonel SIDOMANIDZE）是因出席国际饭店（Park Hotel）的招待会而受到威胁的人员之列。作为证据，提到了《俄罗斯先锋报》（RUSSIAN VANGUARD）的第 153 号。然而实际上，这些人并未出席招待会，当然也没有出现在《俄罗斯先锋报》公布的宾客名单中。

我们理解，罗扎耶夫斯基同志在额外服用了一剂可卡因后，希望与那些曾经不同意“阿塔曼”谢苗诺夫（"Ataman" SEMENOFF）的人算账，但他如果不歪曲引用《俄罗斯先锋报》，难道不是更聪明吗？

是的，罗扎耶夫斯基同志，或者叫罗扎奥苏库桑（ROZAOSUKU SAN，如果你更喜欢后一个名字），你在扮演这种脚踏两只船的高难度角色时必须非常小心。难道你不知道边境两侧的你的主人们是如何对待他们笨拙的仆人的吗？例如，记得你熟知的那位“耶路撒冷哥萨克”(1)的命运吧，他曾为谢苗诺夫“阿塔曼”、布尔什维克以及你现在为之效力的外国势力服务！而他并不是唯一一个被干掉的人！

因此，很难说谁的处境更危险——是你的还是我们的。

我们将拭目以待。目前就此打住。

注 (1) 一名俄罗斯犹太人斯卢茨基（SLOUTSKY），阿塔曼谢苗诺夫随行人员之一，据报道因涉嫌为苏联特工于 1938 年 12 月被日本人“清除”？

Vonsyatsky's Interview

Editor, THE CHINA PRESS
Sir,—It is surprising indeed how a serious daily like your esteemed publication may allot an editorial in its columns in connection with A. Vonsyatsky's visit to Shanghai, thereby attaching a certain degree of importance to the above person.

A. Vonsyatsky, having no true ideology of his own, copies the chauvinistic, man-hating and anti-semitic Nazism of Germany which is proved by reading his publications "Russky Avangard" (Russian Vanguard) and "Fascist." In the course of a "press conference," M. Vonsyatsky had himself asserted that "any alien help" to crush the Soviets will be welcomed, thus linking him with the defeatists. To add that "the leader" had "unavoidably" stopped in Tokyo, for two days would be sufficient to underline the leader's true intentions and ideals.

To attach any sign of importance to a political outcast, a Russian—financed by his American millionaire wife to sponsor the so called "fascist movement" should make a feeling of disgust from an average reader.

Today behind the still surface of the Russian emigrants' life the most obstinate struggle rages on. All arguments of an abstract nature are immediately forgotten. The most hostile of disputes between the partisans of all-defying fascism—working for the defeat of their own Fatherland—and staunch supporters of integrity of the Russian soil goes on, intensified and bitter!

Inasmuch as THE CHINA PRESS for years represented the true Orient's opinion, condemning aggressors, chauvinistic and reactionary cliques, it would not be befitting to laud A. Vonsyatsky's "fascist party," since the party according to perfectly camouflaged leader's statement, is "in no way" linked with the Japanese.

The true substance of M. Vonsyatsky's "fascism" is only too well known to Russian exiles!

Very faithfully yours
"Ravlecca."
February 20, 1939.

冯夏茨基的访谈

致《字林西报》编辑
先生，——贵刊这样严肃的日报竟然在版面上刊登关于 A. 冯夏茨基访问上海的社论，从而赋予此人一定程度的重要性，这确实令人惊讶。

A. 冯夏茨基没有自己的真正意识形态，只是模仿德国那种沙文主义、仇视人类和反犹太主义的纳粹主义，这一点通过阅读他的出版物《俄罗斯先锋报》（Russky Avangard）和《法西斯主义者》（Fascist）即可证明。在一次“新闻发布会”上，冯夏茨基先生本人声称，“任何外来帮助”以粉碎苏维埃都将受到欢迎，从而将他与失败主义者联系在一起。补充说明这位“领袖”“不可避免地”在东京停留了两天，就足以强调该领袖的真实意图和理想。

对一个政治流亡者赋予任何重要性的迹象——一个由他的美国百万富翁妻子资助以赞助所谓“法西斯运动”的俄罗斯人——应该让普通读者感到厌恶。

今天，在俄罗斯移民生活看似平静的表面之下，最顽固的斗争正在激烈进行。所有抽象性质的争论立即被遗忘。无所畏惧的法西斯主义支持者（致力于击败他们自己的祖国）与坚定的俄罗斯领土完整支持者之间最敌对的争端仍在继续，且日益加剧和激烈！

鉴于《字林西报》多年来代表了真正的东方舆论，谴责侵略者、沙文主义者和反动派系，赞扬 A. 冯夏茨基的“法西斯党”是不合适的，因为根据这位伪装完美的领袖的说法，该党与日本人“毫无”联系。

M. 冯夏茨基的“法西斯主义”的真实实质，俄罗斯流亡者再清楚不过了！

您忠实的
“Ravlecca.”
1939 年 2 月 20 日。

Date February 18, 1939.

Subject Reception held in the Park Hotel on 17-2-39 in honour of
Mr. A.A. VONSIATSKY

Made by D.S. Pavloff Forwarded by C. Clasper D.I.

A reception took place in the Dining Room of the
Park Hotel between 5.15 p.m. and 7 p.m. on February 17,
1939 in honour of Mr. A.A. VONSIATSKY - leader of the
"All Russia National Revolutionary Fascist Party" and was
attended by about 200 persons.

Mr. A.A. Vonsiatsky did not appear until about
6 p.m. when he was welcomed by Mr. Stekloff, the Party
leader of the Shanghai branch, after which Mr. A. A.
VONSIATSKY spoke for about thirty-five minutes. In his
speech he outlined the work that has been done by his
party for the past six years.

At about 5 p.m., five Russian Musketeers dressed in
uniform arrived at the party, however, they were advised by
Mr. STEKLOFF to depart and change their dress as the party
was of a purely informal character.

Three persons of Japanese nationality were present
at the reception and as far as it was possible to ascertain
they were representatives of the Russian section of the
Japanese Consulate.

V. MOSKVITIN (C.R.O.2005) and M.P. KAZAKOFF
(S.B. File No.D.8780) were also amongst those present.
MOSKVITIN, who was released from the Municipal Gaol in
August 1937, due to the state of emergency, was serving
a sentence of eight months on a charge of Offering Insult
to a Foreign State (throwing mud at the door of the
Soviet Consulate). KAZAKOFF came to the notice of this
office in connection with a case of passport forging.

No untoward incidents occurred and the party
terminated at about 7 p.m.

D.C. (Special Branch).
A. C. Pavloff.
D. S.

1939 年 2 月 17 日下午 5:15 至 7:00 之间，在国际饭店餐厅举行了 honoring A.A. 冯夏茨基先生的招待会——他是“全俄国家革命法西斯党”的领袖——约有 200 人出席。

A.A. 冯夏茨基先生直到下午 6 点左右才出现，当时他受到了该党上海分支领导人斯特克洛夫先生（Mr. Stekloff）的欢迎，随后 A. A. 冯夏茨基先生发表了约三十五分钟的讲话。在讲话中，他概述了他的政党在过去六年中所做的工作。

下午 5 点左右，五名身穿制服的俄罗斯火枪手抵达派对现场，然而，斯特克洛夫先生建议他们离开并更换服装，因为这次聚会纯属非正式性质。

三名日本国籍人士出席了招待会，据尽可能查明，他们是日本领事馆俄罗斯部的代表。

V. MOSKVITIN (C.R.O.2005) 和 M.P. KAZAKOFF (特别分部档案号 D.8780) 也在出席者之列。莫斯克维京（MOSKVITIN）因紧急状态于 1937 年 8 月从公共租界监狱获释，当时他因侮辱外国罪（向苏联领事馆大门扔泥巴）服刑八个月。卡扎科夫（KAZAKOFF）因一起护照伪造案引起本办公室注意。

未发生任何不幸事件，聚会在下午 7 点左右结束。

D.C. (特别分部)。

Shanghai of Mr. A.A. Vonsiatsky, leader of the "All Russia
National Revolutionary Fascist Party."
Made by D.S. Pavloff Forwarded by C. Crawford. D. V

The cocktail party given for as press, which took
place between 4 p.m. and 5.20 p.m. on the 16-2-39 in
the Green room of the "Park Hotel" on occasion of
arrival in Shanghai of Mr. A.A. Vonsiatsky - leader of
the "All Russia National Revolutionary Fascist Party,"
was attended by about 15 journalists of Russian,
American, German and Italian nationality. Conversation
was held in the English language at first, but on the
departure of the foreign (non Russian) journalists the
conversation was carried on in the Russian language.

Mr. A.A. Vonsiatsky stated that he intended
staying in Shanghai until the 21st of February and
afterwards proceed to Hongkong and then fly to Penang,
where he will board his ship. His intentions at present
are to proceed to Rome, Berlin, London, Paris and New
York.

He expressed pleasure at the growth of his
party and the success of their propaganda in the U.S.S.R.
No untoward incidents occurred and the party
terminated at about 5.20 p.m..

Russians, and it is the aim of our
organization to return Russia to a
free people."
To Dislodge Stalin
Vonsiatsky, who arrived in
Shanghai yesterday by the Presi-
dent Taft on the second of his
globe-encircling tours to muster
support for the cause of his
party, stated that the first aim
of his party was to dislodge the
Stalin Government.
"After that," he continued, "we
will elect a government by the
people and from the people."
"Does that mean that your
organization will support a de-
mocratic Government?—asked a
correspondent.
"Democratic" Fascist
"It is our intention to form a
really democratic Government. The
only really democratic Govern-
ment, I maintain, must be Fascist,"
replied Mr. Vonsiatsky.
After giving correspondents time
to recover from that, the White
Russian leader said that although
his party was not anti-Semitic, it
did not include Jews in its mem-
bership roster.
Asked why, Vonsiatsky replied.
"Perhaps because the Jews are
not interested."
Subsidy Denied
Claiming that his party was
financed purely by members of the
organization and was not sub-
sidized by any foreign power,
Vonsiatsky said that owing to re-
strictive measures in various
countries, his membership was
forced to work "very secretly—very
secretly."

《字林西报》。
1939年2月17日
编号 S. 01781
日期 17日
俄罗斯法西斯首领嫌疑人
日本的目标
领袖抵达
乘坐“塔夫脱总统”号
短暂停留
据称日本人未给予
流亡者明确地位

“我不相信我的组织会参与日本在远东谋求霸权的野心，”佩戴卐字标志、蓝眼睛的“俄罗斯革命法西斯党”领袖 A. A. 冯夏茨基（A. A. Vonsiatsky）昨天在国际饭店接受记者采访时宣称。

这位具有极权主义倾向的访客解释说：“日本人从未就俄罗斯人在远东的地位作出任何保证，也从未保证他们不会入侵俄罗斯领土。”

“俄罗斯，”冯夏茨基在会议上大声说道，“属于俄罗斯人，我们组织的目标是将俄罗斯归还给自由的人民。”

推翻斯大林

冯夏茨基昨天乘“塔夫脱总统”号（President Taft）抵达上海，这是他环球巡回演讲以争取对其政党事业支持的第二站。他表示，他政党的首要目标是推翻斯大林政府。

“在那之后，”他继续说，“我们将选举一个由人民产生、来自人民的政府。”

“这是否意味着贵组织将支持民主政府？”一名记者问道。

“民主的”法西斯主义者

“我们的意图是建立一个真正的民主政府。我坚持认为，唯一真正的民主政府必须是法西斯式的，”冯夏茨基先生回答。

让记者从这一言论中回过神来后，这位白俄领袖表示，虽然他的政党并不反犹，但其成员名单中不包括犹太人。

当被问及原因时，冯夏茨基回答说：
“也许是因为犹太人不感兴趣。”

否认资助

冯夏茨基声称，他的政党纯粹由组织成员资助，不受任何外国势力的补贴。他说，由于各国采取的限制措施，其成员被迫“非常秘密地——非常秘密地”工作。

Subject Expected arrival of A.A. Vonsiatsky in Shanghai.

S.1,
K.V.
DBR
P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.)
2/-

Mr. A.A. VONSIATSKY, naturalized American of Russian origin, who is the leader of the "All-Russia National Revolutionary Fascist Party" ( headquarters at Putnam, Conn., U.S.A. ), is expected to arrive in Shanghai from America today in the s.s. " President Taft". He will be met at the Customs Jetty by a small group of his local followers headed by K.A. Stekloff, after which he will proceed to the Park Hotel where he will stay during his sojourn in this city. He is accompanied by his wife.

Invitations have been sent out by Stekloff to representatives of the local foreign and Chinese press and news agencies to attend a cocktail party which will be held specially for the purpose at 3 p.m. to-day in the Park Hotel.

It is also proposed to hold a tea party for members of the group, their families and friends between 5.15 p.m. and 6 p.m. at the same hotel, with Mr. and Mrs Vonsiatsky as guests of honour. It is reported that over 100 invitations have been sent out for this function, which is intended to be private in character.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 16 FEB. 1939 (DIVISIONS)）

According to information to hand, Mr. and Mrs. Vonsiatsky will leave Shanghai for the South en route to Europe on February 18 aboard the Blue Funnel Line s.s. "Deucalion".

D.S.I. Prokofiev & D.S. Pavloff
will attend the function.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. 3835 Date: January 25, 1939）

Subject Expected arrival of A.A. Vonsiatsky.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.I.

In accordance with the instructions of the D. C.
(Special Branch), Mr. N.S. Romanoff, secretary of the local or-
ganization of the "All-Russia National-Revolutionary Fascist
Party", was informed that in connection with the expected arrival
in Shanghai of Mr. A.A. Vonsiatsky no political meetings of a
public character will be permitted and that the police, being
opposed to any political demonstrations whatsoever, would like
Mr. Vonsiatsky to pass on quietly.

It is reported that Vonsiatsky is now on a round-the-
world trip aboard the s.s. "President Polk". As this ship does
not call at Shanghai, he will take the s.s. "Ranchi" at Kobe,
which is scheduled to arrive in Shanghai on or about February 13.
Vonsiatsky will stay in Shanghai only while the ship is in port
and will rejoin the s.s. "President Polk" in one of the southern
ports.

It appears from the interview with Mr. N.S. Romanoff
that on arrival here he will be met at the Customs Jetty by a
group of his followers. Apart from the tea party in his honour
a reception for the press is likely to be arranged.

FILE
（批：J.B? P.A. to B.C. (Sp. Br.) 25/1）

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch).

由警探长普罗科菲耶夫撰写。由督察克劳福德（Crawford）转呈。

根据特务科副总监的指示，“全俄民族革命法西斯党”当地组织秘书 N.S. 罗曼诺夫先生获悉，鉴于 A.A. 冯夏茨基先生预计抵达上海，不允许举行任何具有公开性质的政治集会，且警方反对任何形式的政治示威，希望冯夏茨基先生低调过境。

据报道，冯夏茨基目前正乘“波尔克总统”号（President Polk）轮船进行环球旅行。由于该船不在上海停靠，他将在神户换乘“兰奇”号（Ranchi）轮船，该船预计于2月13日左右抵达上海。冯夏茨基仅在该船停泊期间留在上海，并将在南方某个港口重新登上“波尔克总统”号轮船。

从与 N.S. 罗曼诺夫先生的谈话来看，他抵达时将由一群追随者在海关码头迎接。除了为他举行的茶话会外，还可能安排一次新闻界招待会。

归档

On 18-1-39 Mr. K.A.Stekloff,head of the local
group of the "All-Russia National-Revolutionary Fascist Party",
called at this office. He stated that Mr. A.A. Vonsiatsky,
leader of the party, is expected to arrive in Shanghai from
the U.S.A. shortly en route to Manila(?)and will stay here for

Further Mr. Stekloff stated that he intends to
make arrangements for a tea party to be held at one of the
leading hotels in the Settlement,most likely at the Cathay
Hotel,where Mr. Vonsiatsky is expected to stay. Admission will
be limited to members of the party, their families and friends-
about 100 persons at the utmost, Mr. and Mrs Vonsiatsky being
the guests of honour. There will be speeches which are bound
to touch on politics.
Although the function is intended to be of a pri-
vate character and,according to Stekloff, will be free from
anything to which the police could possibly object, he would
like to ascertain that there is no police objection to the
scheme as outlined above, before he proceeds with making the
necessary arrangements.

in April,1934 and and in March,1936. During his first sojourn
in this city he delivered a lecture at the Embassy Theatre on
the subject of the Russian Fascist Movement. In 1936,follow-
ing the refusal on the part of the S.M.C. to grant him permis-
sion to give a similar lecture at the Carlton Theatre,he held
a tea party at the Park Hotel,which was attended by about 200
persons.

由警探长普罗科菲耶夫撰写。由高级督察克劳福德转呈。

1939年1月18日，“全俄民族革命法西斯党”当地小组负责人 K.A. 斯特克洛夫先生来访本办公室。他表示，该党领袖 A.A. 冯夏茨基先生预计不久将从美国抵达上海，途经马尼拉（？），并将在此停留几天——可能仅在船只停泊期间。此外，斯特克洛夫先生表示，他打算安排在租界内的一家主要酒店（很可能是冯夏茨基预计下榻的华懋饭店）举行茶话会。入场人员仅限于党员、其家人和朋友——最多约100人，冯夏茨基夫妇为贵宾。届时将有演讲，内容必然涉及政治。

虽然此次活动意在具有私人性质，且据斯特克洛夫称，不会包含任何警方可能反对的内容，但他希望在着手进行必要安排之前，确认警方对上述方案没有异议。

值得一提的是，冯夏茨基曾于1934年4月和1936年3月访问过上海。在他第一次逗留期间，他在大使剧院发表了关于俄罗斯法西斯运动的演讲。1936年，在工部局拒绝批准他在卡尔登剧院发表类似演讲后，他在国际饭店举行了一次茶话会，约有200人参加。

SPECIAL POLICE

No. 198 Date 2/6/39

Translation from the "Russian Vanguard", December 18 1938, publi-
shed by the "Russian Vanguard Publishing Co., 749 Bubbling Well
Road, Room 207. Editor - Mr. K.A. Stekloff.

Translation of extract from the speech delivered
by K.A.Stekloff during the course of a private
meeting of members of the "All-Russia National-
Revolutionary Fascist Party" which was held on
8-12-38 at the club of the Party, 749 Bubbling
Well Road.

......"We, Russian Fascists, faithfully following the call of
the Russian Nation, must help Russia to shake off the internatio-
nal communistic rot and defend our old Russian territory and the
sanctity of the frontiers of our Russian Empire against the designs
of various "sweet" and "obliging" foreign "protectors" and "bene-
factors", who crave to obtain the control over Russian people and
territory up to the Urals from one side and up to Volga from the
other, leaving to Russians a small "-go" of some kind to remind
them of the name "Russia"-exactly as it is being done with Carpa-
thic Russians who are now transformed in Ukrainians.

Take for instance the "fervent" prayers to God for the
granting of victory to foreign arms in conquering our territory
and our Russian people, our old granaries in Siberia and Far East.
- prayers of Mitrofan the Second of Wayside¹) and other scum, who
carry out night-pots from under the beds of the conquerors for
Y.30 per month and more often for nothing - just because of their
vile nature, just in the hope to receive from the conquerors in
future various posts and appointments... Vileness is vileness
and treachery is always treachery.. There have always been trai-
tors among all peoples including the Russian people..."

Translator's note: One of the nicknames of notorious Mitrofan
Tretiakoff.
Another Russian living in Wayside district,
M.Beznosiuk, a harmless and, apparently, men-
tally deranged individual calls himself "Mit-
rofan the First"..

I.C.S.B.
20/1.

第198号 日期 1939年2月6日

译自《俄罗斯先锋报》，1938年12月18日出版，由“俄罗斯先锋出版公司”发行，地址：静安寺路749号207室。编辑：K.A. 斯捷克洛夫先生。

译文节选自 K.A. 斯捷克洛夫在“全俄民族革命法西斯党”成员于1938年12月8日在该党俱乐部（静安寺路749号）举行的私人会议上发表的讲话。

……“我们，俄罗斯法西斯主义者，忠实地遵循俄罗斯民族的召唤，必须帮助俄罗斯摆脱国际共产主义的腐朽，捍卫我们古老的俄罗斯领土以及俄罗斯帝国边界的神圣性，使其免受各种‘甜美’且‘殷勤’的外国‘保护者’和‘恩人’的图谋侵害，这些人渴望从一侧控制俄罗斯人民及领土直至乌拉尔山，从另一侧直至伏尔加河，只留给俄罗斯人某种缩写的‘-go’以提醒他们‘俄罗斯’这个名字——正如现在对喀尔巴阡俄罗斯人所做的那样，他们已被转变为乌克兰人。

试看那些为外国军队征服我们的领土和我们俄罗斯人民、我们在西伯利亚和远东的古老粮仓而向上帝发出的‘热烈’祈祷——这是路边区¹) 的米特罗凡二世及其他渣滓的祈祷，他们每月收取30日元甚至经常免费为征服者从床下倒夜壶——这仅仅是因为他们卑劣的本性，只是希望在未来从征服者那里获得各种职位和任命……卑劣就是卑劣，背叛永远是背叛……在所有民族中，包括俄罗斯民族在内，一直都有叛徒……”

译者注：臭名昭著的米特罗凡·特里亚科夫（Mitrofan Tretiakoff）的绰号之一。
另一位居住在路边区的俄罗斯人 M. Beznoziuk，一个无害且显然精神错乱的人，自称“米特罗凡一世”。

工部局警务处

"Russian Vanguard", № 18, 1930

ЖИЗНЬ
ПО СЕКТОРАМ, ГРУППАМ И ОТДѢЛАМ

Дальне - Восточный Центр.

Пятница 9-го Декабря.

Пятничный очередной доклад партійцами был прослушан с напряженнѣйшим вниманіем и захватывающим интересом. Доклад, как всегда, был открыт ровно в 8 часов вечера Руководителем Дальне - Восточнаго Центра сор. К. А. Стѣкловым. Въ своем словѣ сор. К. А. Стѣклов сказал, что мы Русскіе Націоналисты — Рыцари Бѣлой Священной Свастики должны поддержать нашими силами разгар стихійнаго пламени Національной Революціи нынѣ полыхающей своим огнем во всем могуществѣ по Россійским дебрям.

Мы должны готовиться и при этом готовиться спѣшно отбросив, все въ сторону, наряжая себя Націоналъ - Революціонной динамикой — фашистских доктрин. На нашей Родинѣ, нам родной нам, Русскій народ ведет смертельную борьбу о властью сатаны интернаціональной шайкой коммунистов и на Сталинской террор сверху отвчает низовым террором народнаго Россійскаго гнѣва. И никаких процессов эволюціи Соввласти, ни тѣм болѣе Націонализаціи СССР нѣтъ и не происходит. Единственно, что там творится въ эти дни — это междоусобное самопожирание, из за страха друг пред другом опьянѣвших от русской крови коммунистических скорпіонов.

Безпрецендентным режимом террора Сталин еще едва удерживает свою власть над возмутившейся русской натурой, уже готовой влить своя силы въ ряды грядущей Національной Революціи. День возмездія грядет! Русская Нація встает от она и очищается от коммунистическаго опіума и выпрямляет свою Національную быль во всем своем Россійском могуществѣ.

И мы, русскіе Фашисты, свято слѣдуя волѣ Русской Націи должны помочь Ей стряхнуть съ Ея тѣла интернаціональную коммунистическую пыль и защитить наши исконные Россійскіе земли и неприкосновенность наших границ Россійской Имперіи, от столь «любезных» и «услужливых» помощников чужестранных «покровителей» и благотворителей», так страстно желающих расчленить Русскаго народа и земель съ одной стороны по Урал, а съ другой по Волгу матушку красавицу, ну, а русским можно оставить как память сокращенное «ГО» и только, а само названіе Россія уничтожить, как это сдѣлано уже съ Прикарпатской Русью, насилуя исконное Русское населеніе и безутѣшно проводя Украинизацію. А «усердное» моленіе Господу Богу о дарованіи побѣды оружію иноземному при покореніи наших земель и нашего Русскаго народа, наших Сибиряков и Дальне - Восточных исконных жителей Россіи, как это дѣлают и дѣлает г-н Митрофанъ ІІ-й Всевѣдующій и всякая прочая другая гниль, вынесшая горшки на пл., кроватей завоевателей за тридцать іен, а чаще на своей подлости даром, въ одной лишь надеждѣ на будущее и ожидающих от завоевателей всяких назначеній и постов. Подлость есть подлость, а предательство есть предательство и предатели всегда были и есть среди всѣх народов въ том числѣ и Русскаго.

Нѣтъ соратники! Для Русских Фашистов цѣлость территоріальных границ является не только вопросом чести, но и смысла всего существованія и даже самой жизни, да и сущность то Національной грядущей Революціи это Національное возрожденіе Русской Націи и сохраненіе русских земель, так усердно разбазариваемых коммунистами.

Нѣтъ для Русскаго Фашиста страны прекраснѣе Россіи, нѣтъ ничего что бы въ его пониманіи могло доминировать над понятіем Россія Россія прежде, всего и выше всего. Россія должна быть Русской и только для Русских.

Далѣе съ докладом выступил сор. Л. Б. Даниловъ взявъ темой свою труда «Интеллигенція и ея роль въ грядущей Національной Революціи».

《俄罗斯先锋报》，1930年第18期

生活
按部门、小组和分部

远东中心。

12月9日，星期五。

党员们以极度专注和浓厚的兴趣聆听了周五的例行报告。像往常一样，报告于晚上8点整由远东中心负责人斯捷克洛夫同志（K. A. Steklov）宣布开始。斯捷克洛夫同志在发言中表示，我们俄罗斯民族主义者——白色神圣卐字的骑士，必须用我们的力量支持目前正以其全部威力在俄罗斯荒野中熊熊燃烧的民族革命烈火的高潮。

我们必须做好准备，并且要迅速准备，抛开一切，用民族革命的动力——法西斯主义教义来武装自己。在我们亲爱的祖国，俄罗斯人民正在与国际共产主义匪帮的撒旦权力进行殊死搏斗，并以底层俄罗斯民众愤怒的恐怖来回应斯大林自上而下的恐怖。苏维埃政权没有任何进化过程，更不用说苏联的民族化了，这些既不存在也没有发生。目前在那里发生的唯一事情就是因彼此恐惧而醉心于俄罗斯鲜血的共产主义蝎子之间的自相残杀。

斯大林通过前所未有的恐怖统治，勉强维持着他对已经准备好将力量注入即将到来的民族革命行列的愤慨的俄罗斯本性的控制。复仇之日即将来临！俄罗斯民族从昏迷中苏醒，清除共产主义鸦片，并以全部的俄罗斯力量挺直其民族脊梁。

而我们，俄罗斯法西斯主义者，神圣地遵循俄罗斯民族的意志，必须帮助她抖落身上的国际共产主义尘埃，保护我们古老的俄罗斯土地和俄罗斯帝国边界的不可侵犯性，使其免受那些如此“亲切”和“殷勤”的外国“保护者”和“慈善家”的援助，他们热切希望将俄罗斯人民和土地从一侧沿乌拉尔山、从另一侧沿美丽的母亲河伏尔加河进行分割，嗯，至于俄罗斯人，可以留给他们一个简写的“GO”作为纪念，仅此而已，并消灭“俄罗斯”这个名称本身，就像对喀尔巴阡罗斯所做的那样，强奸古老的俄罗斯人口并无望地进行乌克兰化。而那些为外国武器在征服我们的土地和我们俄罗斯人民、我们的西伯利亚人和远东俄罗斯古老居民时取得胜利而向主上帝进行的“勤勉”祈祷，正如全知者米特罗凡二世先生和其他各种垃圾所做的那样，他们以三十日元的价格，或者更多时候出于卑鄙免费地为征服者搬出卧室里的便盆，仅仅怀着对未来的希望，期待从征服者那里获得各种任命和职位。卑鄙就是卑鄙，背叛就是背叛，叛徒在所有民族中始终存在，俄罗斯民族也不例外。

不，同志们！对于俄罗斯法西斯主义者来说，领土边界的完整不仅是一个荣誉问题，而且是整个存在乃至生命本身的意义所在，而且即将到来的民族革命的本质正是俄罗斯民族的民族复兴和保护被共产主义者如此勤勉地挥霍掉的俄罗斯土地。

对于俄罗斯法西斯主义者来说，没有比俄罗斯更美好的国家，在他的理解中，没有任何东西能凌驾于“俄罗斯”这一概念之上，俄罗斯首先且高于一切。俄罗斯必须是俄罗斯的，且仅属于俄罗斯人。

随后，达尼洛夫同志（L. B. Danilov）作了题为《知识分子及其在即将到来的民族革命中的作用》的报告。

re 717144
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by Chanoore 67 P.J

Following the visit to Shanghai in March, 1936, of A.A.
Vonsiatsky, the leader of the so-called "All-Russia People's
Revolutionary Party of Fascists" and thanks to the financial
support, about U.S.$150 per month, he is reported to have since
been according his local followers, the latter have been able
to show a certain amount of activity. This includes the
establishment of a permanent office of the "Far Eastern Centre"
of the party, a reading room and recreation centre for its
members at No. 1454 Avenue Edward VII (Flat 318) and the
regular publication of a weekly newspaper entitled "Russian
Vanguard," the printing office of which is at present situated
at House 67-Q, Passage 7, Chengtu Road.

Regular meetings of members of the party and their friends
interested in the Fascist movement take place once a week at
1454 Avenue Edward VII, at which address also a "Party School"
and an "Employment Bureau" are supposed to be functioning. It
is reported that the membership is about 80 persons. This
group is in a sharp opposition to the pro-Japanese and pro-
Ataman Semenoff "All Russia Fascist Party".

From personal contact with K.A. Stekloff, head of this
group, it appears that he has neither sufficient education nor
experience which a political leader would be expected to
possess. This may account for the very low standard and
poor ideological contents of the "Russian Vanguard," and may
also explain Stekloff's marked tendency towards activities of
a purely external character, such as : formation of a "storm
group," a "battle group" and a "phalanx," the respective
functions of which are not quite clear; display of fascist
uniform and party emblem; introduction of a ceremony of oath

继所谓“全俄人民革命法西斯党”领导人 A.A. 冯西亚茨基于1936年3月访问上海之后，得益于他据报道此后向其本地追随者提供的每月约150美元的财政支持，后者得以表现出一定程度的活动。这包括在爱德华七世路1454号（318室）设立党的“远东中心”常设办事处、成员阅览室和娱乐中心，并定期出版名为《俄罗斯先锋报》的周报，其印刷厂目前位于成都路7弄67-Q号。

党员及对法西斯运动感兴趣的朋友的定期会议每周在爱德华七世路1454号举行一次，该地址据说还设有“党校”和“就业介绍所”。据报道，成员人数约为80人。该团体与亲日及亲阿塔曼谢苗诺夫的“全俄法西斯党”处于尖锐对立状态。

通过与该团体负责人 K.A. 斯捷克洛夫的个人接触来看，他似乎缺乏政治领袖所应具备的足够教育和经验。这或许可以解释《俄罗斯先锋报》水准极低且意识形态内容贫乏的原因，也可以解释斯捷克洛夫明显倾向于纯粹外在形式的活动，例如：组建“风暴组”、“战斗组”和“方阵”，其各自职能尚不清楚；展示法西斯制服和党徽；引入宣誓仪式

    From the police viewpoint there seems to be no objection
to these activities provided that they are conducted in an
orderly manner and do not tend to create a breach of the
public peace and order.  Stekloff, it would appear, fully
realises that a conflict with the Settlement authorities may
result in the suppression of his group and, consequently, in
the withdrawal of the financial support by Vonsiatsky.  This
he can ill afford to bear, as he is unemployed and seems to be
dependent on Vonsiatsky's subsidy.  At the same time there
are reasons to believe that he may be easily influenced by
persons who are likely to involve him in a trouble.  As an
instance, his connection with Dr. N. Ph. Bogunsky (File F.2288)
may be mentioned, which at present has been broken off.  This
individual made an attempt in November last to utilize the
Stekloff group for anti-Semitic activities.

may also attract the attention of certain quarters and provoke

NOTIFICATION

On the following Thursday the administrative
section of the Fascist Centre in the Far East will be
removed to the new premises - 1454 Avenue Edward VII,
Flat 318.

In the new building provided with technical fittings,
the Fascist Headquarters will put in motion the entire
apparatus of their cultural and propagandist institutions,
courses, fascist school etc......

The editorial offices of the RUSSIAN VANGUARD will
also be situated at this address.

Mr. K. A. Stekloff, Chief of the Centre, receives
visitors on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays between 6 p.m.
and 7 p.m.

Offices of all sections are open to visitors during
office hours.

Party meetings, lectures, meetings of commissions
will take place in the same premises.

The EMPLOYMENT BUREAU will function at the same
address.

The next party meeting will take place on October 29
at 8 p.m.. The Chief of the Centre will make a report.

All members of the party are to attend. Invitations
will be sent out to friends and sympathisers.

Что такое Фашизмъ?

Богъ, Нація и Трудъ — стержни націоналъ — фашистской жизни.
Фашизмъ — это корпоративное устройство государственной жизни Великой Трудовой

Фашизмъ — это рабоче — крестьянскій союзъ города и деревни на мирныхъ поляхъ и

Фашизмъ — добровольное содружество Труда и Капитала, регулируемое государствен-

Фашизмъ — власть народа для Русскаго народа.

Фашизмъ есть Миръ всему Міру во имя человѣчности отношеній всѣхъ народовъ.
Фашизмъ — это Знаніе и Свѣтъ.
Фашизмъ — стремительный прогрессъ Науки, Техники и Промышленности.

pages.zh:
荣耀归于俄罗斯！

— 民族革命万岁！ —

— 我们的领袖万岁！ —

法西斯主义即生命。
领 — 袖
共产主义即死亡！
全俄法西斯人民革命党
A. A. 冯夏茨基 。

什么是法西斯主义？

上帝、民族和劳动——是民族法西斯主义生活的核心。
法西斯主义是大劳动民族俄罗斯国家生活的社团化组织。
法西斯主义是城市与乡村在和平田野上和工厂机床旁的工农联盟。
法西斯主义是在国家权力调节下，劳动与资本的自愿合作。
法西斯主义是为俄罗斯人民服务的俄罗斯人民政权。
法西斯主义是所有阶级在工人温饱、农民富裕的繁荣俄罗斯人口中的社团化劳动团结。
法西斯主义是以全人类各民族人道关系为名，给世界带来和平。
法西斯主义是知识与光明。

Attached herewith together with translation I forward
specimens of a leaflet in Russian bearing Fascist slogans,
copies of which are reported to have been distributed in the
streets of the French Concession on October 11.
These leaflets were, in all probability, printed at
No. 488 Taku Road where is situated the office of the local
group of followers of A.A. Vonsiatsky, the leader of the
so-called "All-Russia People's Revolutionary Fascist Party."
At the same address are also situated the editorial and printing
offices of the weekly Russian newspaper entitled "RUSSIAN VANGUARD"
which is published by the group in question. It is reported
that leaflets intended for secret transportation into the
U.S.S.R. are printed at this address from time to time.
The local branch of Vonsiatsky's party was established in
1934 following this individual's visit to Shanghai. So far, it
has not been active and, it is reported, exists only thanks to
financial support accorded by Vonsiatsky, a naturalized American
of Russian origin, whose wife is believed to possess a considerable
fortune.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.
Following the refusal on the part of the S.M.C. to grant
permission to A. A. Vonsiatsky to give a lecture at the
Carlton Theatre on March 22 on the subject of the Russian
national movement, Vonsiatsky made arrangements to hold a
tea party at the Park Hotel with the intention of delivering
his lecture during the function. Some 200 invitations were
sent out. On receipt of this information a call was made
on Mr. Reiger, representative of the management of the hotel,
by D. I. Ross and D.S.I. Duncan at 12.30 p.m. March 22 when
it was explained that there was a possibility of the function
developing into a political meeting. Mr. Reiger promised
that Vonsiatsky would be warned to refrain from touching on
politics if he made a speech.
The invitations were for 4 p.m. and by that time about
200 guests had gathered in the dining room on the 2nd floor
of the hotel. K. A. Stekloff, Vonsiatsky's local representative,
assisted by A. N. Lenkoff and Chudimoff, members of the same
group, welcomed the guests. Admittance was strictly confined
to those in possession of invitation cards.

followers wearing fascist uniform, made his appearance and
delivered a short speech in which he explained that the
authorities of the Settlement had refused him permission to
deliver a lecture at the Carlton Theatre and that the manage-
ment of the hotel had warned him that the Police would
interfere if he attempted to do so during the tea party.

Tea-Party à la Americain.

400 "chosen" Russians had the high privilege of seeing
and listening to the new "liberator" and "leader "
Anastace Vonsiatsky.

A private tea party was given to "certain" members of
the Russian community in a large room of the Park Hotel
by Vonsiatsky who claims to be the leader of the Russian
Fascist Movement.

No one was admitted who was unable to produce a special
invitation card. It is of interest to note that a certain
member of the "Mladorossy Party", Mr. V.V.K., who had not
received any invitation but, nevertheless, made an attempt
to obtain permission to be present at the function on the
strength of a letter of recommendation from a well known
person, but without success.

The "chosen ones" were welcomed by Mrs. Vonsiatsky who
led the guests to their respective places and saw that each
of them was given tea and sandwiches.

Young people predominated among the guests, although some
of the "old boys" were also noticed, such as Admiral
Fedorovitch, General Smolin, N.A. Ivanoff, Klueff, Sunnenberg
and others.

Following his appearance in the room Vonsiatsky did not
let himself to be introduced to each of the guests, but
greeted the audience as a whole, after which he made a short
address to them on the subject of the present political
situation in Russia. He pointed out to the tasks which,
according to his opinion, the Russian Fascist Party, the
Fascist Movement among Russian emigres as well as among young
people in the U.S.S.R., had to carry out for the cause of
the restoration of National Russia.

His address was received with a great interest. There

美式茶话会。

400名“精选”的俄国人享有殊荣，得以瞻仰并聆听新的“解放者”和“领袖”阿纳斯塔斯·冯西亚茨基（Anastace Vonsiatsky）的言论。

自称是俄国法西斯运动领袖的冯西亚茨基，在国际饭店的一个大房间里为俄国社区的“某些”成员举办了一场私人茶话会。

“精选之人”受到冯西亚茨基夫人的欢迎，她引导宾客入座，并确保每人都享用了茶点和三明治。

宾客中以年轻人为主，但也注意到一些“老资格”人物，如费多罗维奇海军上将（Admiral Fedorovitch）、斯莫林将军（General Smolin）、N.A. 伊万诺夫（N.A. Ivanoff）、克卢耶夫（Klueff）、孙嫩伯格（Sunnenberg）等人。

Translation from the "Shanghai Zaria" of March 23, 1936.

AT THE RECEPTION OF A. A. VONSIATSKY

At 4 p.m. yesterday Mr. and Mrs. A. A. Vonsiatsky held
a tea party in the tea-room of the Park Hotel. About
200 guests attended. They were welcomed by Mrs. Vonsiatsky,
as at the beginning of the function her husband was absent.
Admittance was strictly controlled and only those in
possession of special invitation cards could enter.
Mr. Vonsiatsky appeared three quarters of an hour after
the beginning of the function. He and his attendants wore
a khaki uniforms.
"Friends", said Mr. Vonsiatsky: "I intended to take the
opportunity of your presence here in order to make a short
communication on the general situation. The authorities
did not grant me permission to make this communication at
the Carlton Theatre. I regret that I am unable to make it
even here, as an hour prior to the reception, the manager
of the hotel called on me and stated that should I make a
speech, the police would interfere. Therefore I am
compelled to limit myself by making only a short appeal to
you: It is high time to mobilize all our forces as the
decisive moment is approaching! All our combatants must
ask themselves, what had they done for the cause of the
National Revolution. A silent support, an approving nod
is not enough now. One must act! Every one must increase
tenfold one's activities for the cause of liberation of
our motherland! Now is no time for apathy and desertion!
Every one must act!
Every member of the party must do his utmost in order
to be useful to his country. Every one who formerly was a
member of the party but subsequently stood aside must
forget about former blunders. Every one who has not yet
joined the party must do so now. Every one who is not
sufficiently informed regarding the aims and the tasks of
the party must study them as there is no knowledge more

译自1936年3月23日的《上海黎明报》（Shanghai Zaria）。

在 A. A. 冯西亚茨基的招待会上

昨日下午4时，A. A. 冯西亚茨基夫妇在国际饭店的茶室举行茶话会。约有200名宾客出席。活动开始时因冯西亚茨基先生缺席，由冯西亚茨基夫人对宾客表示欢迎。
入场受到严格控制，只有持有特别请柬者方可进入。
冯西亚茨基先生在活动开始三刻钟后出现。他和他的随从均身着卡其色制服。
“朋友们，”冯西亚茨基先生说：“我本想利用各位在此的机会，就总体局势作一简要通报。当局未批准我在卡尔登大戏院作此通报。我很遗憾，即使在这里我也无法进行通报，因为在招待会前一小时，饭店经理拜访了我，并表示如果我发表演讲，警方将进行干预。因此，我被迫仅限于向各位发出简短呼吁：动员我们所有力量的时候已经到了，因为决定性时刻即将来临！我们所有的战斗员都必须自问，他们为民族革命事业做了什么。沉默的支持、赞许的点头现在已不够了。必须行动！每个人都必须将为解放祖国而进行的努力增加十倍！现在不是冷漠和退缩的时候！每个人都必须行动！

18th March, 1936.

Mr. A. A. Vonsiatsky,
Suite No. 905,
Park Hotel,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I regret the delay in replying to your
letter of March 14 asking if there would be any
objection on the part of the Council to a lecture
to be given by you at the Carlton Theatre on the
subject of The Russian National Movement.

The Council appreciates your statement
that the lecture will be educational and not in-
flammatory, but cannot overlook the fact that the
lecture must be mainly of a political character.
It is difficult to draw distinctions between poli-
tical addresses, and the Council prefers not to
establish any precedent in this matter.

I have therefore to inform you that the
Council considers that it has a reasonable objection
to the giving of the lecture.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient Servant,

J. R. JONES

Secretary.

With reference to the memo of D.C. (Special Branch)
dated March 16, 1936, on the subject of A.A. Vonsiatsky, this
individual's antecedents and political activities as known to
the Municipal Police, are as follows:-
Anastace A. Vonsiatsky is a Russian who was born
in 1898 at Warsaw. His father under the Tsarist regime in
Russia held the post of a Colonel in the Special Gendarmerie
Corps (Political Police) and was killed by Russian revolution-
ists shortly prior to the Great War. During the civil war
in Russia he fought against the bolsheviks and following the
defeat of the "White" Army made his way to Constantinople and
from there to France and the U.S.A., where he subsequently
married and acquired American citizenship. His wife, Mrs.
Marion R. Vonsiatsky, 59, is reported to be the daughter of
a wealthy American and to possess a considerable fortune
($10,000,000, if a newspaper report is to be believed).
While in exile, Vonsiatsky took an active part in
anti-bolshevik movement among Russian emigres. In 1932 he
made his first trip to France, Germany and Jugoslavia for
the purpose of promoting ideas of the Russian Fascist movement,
and has since been connected with that movement.
The first signs of a more or less organized Fascist
movement among Russian emigres refer to 1927 when a declaration
was published by the so-called "National Organization of
Russian Fascists" in Jugoslavia in which fundamental principles
of its activities were expounded and Russian patriots were
called upon to rally around the banners bearing the three
basic slogans of the Russian Fascisti: "GOD, NATION, LABOUR".

关于特别分部副督察（D.C. (Special Branch)）于1936年3月16日就A.A. 冯夏茨基一事所发的备忘录，现将工部局警务处所知的该人的背景及政治活动陈述如下：

阿纳斯塔斯·A·冯夏茨基（Anastace A. Vonsiatsky）是一名俄罗斯人，1898年生于华沙。其父在沙皇俄国时期担任特别宪兵队（政治警察）上校职务，并在大战前夕不久被俄国革命者杀害。在俄国内战期间，他对抗布尔什维克，随着“白军”战败，他辗转至君士坦丁堡，随后前往法国和美国，并在那里结婚并入籍美国。据报道，其妻马里昂·R·冯夏茨基夫人（Mrs. Marion R. Vonsiatsky），59岁，系一富有的美国人之女，拥有巨额财富（据某报纸报道，达10,000,000美元）。

流亡期间，冯夏茨基积极参与俄国侨民中的反布尔什维克运动。1932年，他首次前往法国、德国和南斯拉夫，旨在推广俄国法西斯运动的理念，此后便与该运动保持联系。

in Shanghai after three weeks' absence, Vonsiatsky delivered
at the Embassy Theatre on May 21 a lecture on the Russian
National Movement and left for Europe on the following day.
While in Shanghai, he endeavoured to establish a
branch of the "All-Russia Fascist Party" here, but the
interest, which his arrival undoubtedly aroused among local
Russians, soon died away owing to the general disappointment
in his personality as a leader, as well as to his haphazard
manner of carrying out his mission. The only practical result
of his visit to Shanghai was the formation of several groups
of Fascist sympathisers who, not being unified into one body,
recognized the Harbin Executive Committee as their centre.
With the exception of holding one or two public lectures,
their activity in Shanghai was limited to distribution of the
Fascist literature and the "Nash Put" which became the central
organ of the "All-Russia Fascist Party".
Towards the end of 1934 an open breach took place
between the Harbin Group of the Party and their newly elected
leader. Vonsiatsky's hostile attitude towards Ataman Semenoff,
the Japanese protégé in Manchuria, is believed to have been
the main point of his disagreement with the Harbin group.
To this may be added his negative attitude towards the violently
anti-Semitic and anti-Masonic campaign carried on by the Harbin
Fascisti, and, last but not least, a feeling of disappointment
on the part of the latter, whose expectations of a large financial
support from Vonsiatsky did not materialize.

离开三周后回到上海，冯夏茨基于5月21日在大使剧院（Embassy Theatre）发表了关于俄国民族运动的演讲，并于次日前往欧洲。

在上海期间，他试图在此建立“全俄法西斯党”的一个分部，但他的到来无疑在当地俄国人中激起的兴趣很快便消退了，原因是人们对他作为领袖的个人品质普遍感到失望，以及他执行使命的方式杂乱无章。他访问上海的唯一实际成果是形成了一些法西斯同情者小组，这些小组未统一为一个整体，承认哈尔滨执行委员会为其中心。除了举办一两次公开讲座外，他们在上海的活动仅限于分发法西斯文献和《我们的道路》，后者已成为“全俄法西斯党”的中心机关报。

1934年底，该党的哈尔滨小组与其新当选的领导人之间发生了公开破裂。据信，冯夏茨基对日本在满洲的 protégé（受保护者/代理人）谢苗诺夫阿塔曼（Ataman Semenoff）的敌对态度，是他与哈尔滨小组分歧的主要点。此外，还有他对哈尔滨法西斯主义者进行的激烈的反犹太和反共济会运动的否定态度，以及最后但同样重要的一点，即后者因指望从冯夏茨基那里获得大量财政支持的期望落空而感到失望。

    The object of the present trip of Vonsiatsky is re-

as well as in his general political activities he is not likely
to be supported by any government and it is not known that
he depends on financial support of any private individuals,
with the exception of his wife. That he is in the position
to finance the activities of various organs of the party and
actually does so, is a well established fact. This, in the
opinion of many, constitutes his only qualification for the
leadership of the Fascist Party.
    With regard to the support likely to be accorded
to him by members of the local Russian community, there are
good reasons to believe that although the Fascist ideas may
be popular among the "Whites" neither Vonsiatsky himself nor
his local representative can boast of being popular in Shanghai,
after the very poor show the "Leader" made of himself during
his first sojourn in this city. Even within the Fascist
ranks in Shanghai, there are two factions which are hostile
to Vonsiatsky, and his followers under Stekloff are neither
numerous nor influential.

    据报，冯西亚茨基（Vonsiatsky）此次出行的目的是视察和组织该党在各国的分部。在执行其特定任务以及开展一般政治活动方面，他不太可能得到任何政府的支持，除其妻子外，也不已知他依赖任何私人的财政支持。他有能力资助该党各机构的活动并确实如此行事，这是一个既定事实。在许多看来，这构成了他领导法西斯党的唯一资格。
    关于当地俄侨社区成员可能给予他的支持，有充分理由相信，尽管法西斯思想在“白俄”中可能颇受欢迎，但无论是冯西亚茨基本人还是其本地代表，都无法夸口在上海受到欢迎，因为这位“领袖”在其首次逗留本市期间表现极为糟糕。即使在上海的法西斯阵营内部，也有两个派系对冯西亚茨基持敌对态度，而他在斯特克洛夫（Stekloff）麾下的追随者既人数不多也缺乏影响力。

Dear Sir,

On Sunday, March 22nd., I am desirous of giving
a lecture at the Carlton Theatre at 7.30 p.m. on the
subject of "The Russian National Movement".

I guarantee that admission to the lecture is
by private invitation and that the general public will
not be admitted. I also assure you that the lecture will
be educational and not inflammatory or liable to excite
feelings or give rise to a breach of the peace.

I am writing to ask if there will be any objection
to my giving the lecture at the place and hour designated.

Awaiting your kind reply, I beg to remain,

Respectfully yours,

Anastase A. Vonsiatsky.

Made by D.S.Tcheremshansky Forwarded by DB Ross D.I.

Information has been received from a fairly reliable
source that Anastasy A. Vonsiatsky, the leader of a branch of the
Russian Fascist movement, (File D.5835), will arrive in Shanghai
from the U.S.A. on March 9, 1936 in the s.s. "President Adams".
He is accomapnied by Colonel Bek Mamedoff, his brother-in-law and
associate. Vonsiatsky is expected to remain in Shanghai for about
one week, after which he intends to proceed to Germany.
It is also reported that while at Shanghai he intends
to hold a public lecture on the subject of the Russian Fascist
movement, similar to the lecture he delivered at the Embassy
Theatre on 21.5.34 during his first sojourn in Shanghai. His
proposed visit to Germany is believed to be in connection with
the establishment of a friendly contact with the leaders of the
German National-Socialist Party (Nazi), who, it is reported,
recently invited representatives of certain Russian active anti-
communist organisations to visit Germany for that purpose.

D.S. Tcheremshansky
D.B.R.

With reference to the attached translation of article, which appeared in the "SLOVO" of December 18, 1934, on the subject of A. Vonsiatsky's expulsion from the ranks of the All-Russian Fascist Party, I forward herewith a brief outline of the activities of Russian Fascisti in the Far East, as well as of the circumstances, which have led to the incident referred to above.

The first attempt to organize politically active elements among Russian emigrants into a party with a programme based on Fascist principles was made in November, 1926, when the so-called "National Organization of Russian Fascisti" was established in Yugoslavia. In 1927 a declaration was published by that organization, in which fundamental principles of its activities were expounded and Russian patriots were called upon to rally around the banners bearing the three basic slogans of the Russian Fascisti: "GOD, NATION, LABOUR". The programme of the Russian Fascisti has certain common features with several other Russian political factions of post-revolutionary formation, such as "Mladorossy", "Rosnazi", etc., insofar as they have definitely abandoned the idea of restoration of the pre-revolutionary Russia and strive, by means of a "national revolution", to overthrow the communist regime in Russia, after which a "Third Russia" will be built up on new economic and social foundations.

The Russian Fascisti maintain that the bankruptcy of both the capitalist and communist forms of organization of society is evident and, therefore, advocate the establishment of a new system, which they describe as "SOLIDARISM" and which is based on subordination of all personal and class interests to...

主题（全称） A. 冯西亚茨基被全俄法西斯党开除。

制作人 D.S.I. 普罗科菲耶夫 转发人 [签名] D.I.

关于随附的1934年12月18日《斯洛沃报》（SLOVO）上刊登的关于 A. 冯西亚茨基被全俄法西斯党开除的文章译文，兹附上远东俄罗斯法西斯分子活动概况，以及导致上述事件的情况简述。

第一次尝试将俄罗斯流亡者中政治活跃的分子组织成一个以法西斯原则为纲领的政党是在1926年11月，当时在南斯拉夫成立了所谓的“俄罗斯法西斯民族组织”。1927年，该组织发表了一份宣言，阐述了其活动的基本原则，并呼吁俄罗斯爱国者团结在印有俄罗斯法西斯三大基本口号的旗帜周围：“上帝、民族、劳动”。俄罗斯法西斯分子的纲领与后革命时期形成的其他几个俄罗斯政治派别，如“青年俄罗斯派”（Mladorossy）、“俄罗斯纳粹”（Rosnazi）等，有一定的共同特征，因为它们都明确放弃了恢复革命前俄罗斯的想法，并试图通过“民族革命”推翻俄罗斯的共产主义政权，之后将在新的经济和社会基础上建设“第三俄罗斯”。

俄罗斯法西斯分子认为，资本主义和共产主义两种社会组织形式的破产是显而易见的，因此主张建立一种新制度，他们称之为“连带主义”（SOLIDARISM），其基础是将所有个人和阶级利益服从于……

（左侧手写批注：这是一个准政党，这就是法西斯主义的实质 日期 1936年1月2日 " 1944年3月23日 B.I.）

        自1927年以来，在包括中国在内的俄罗斯侨民居住的各种国家中，成立了俄罗斯法西斯主义团体。哈尔滨团体在人数上一直是最强大的团体之一，并且在日本在满洲发动政变后，由于据称满洲的日本当局给予该派俄罗斯侨民的道义和物质支持，逐渐变得引人注目。1933年，哈尔滨开始出版一份名为《我们的道路》（"NASH PUT"）的法西斯刊物，该刊物此后一直大力宣扬法西斯思想，猛烈攻击一般的共产主义者，特别是犹太裔共产主义者和亲共犹太人。同时，该报主张俄罗斯爱国者与日本密切合作。自1927年以来存在于上海的“远东俄罗斯法西斯主义者全国组织”分部总体上并不活跃。

1934 Vonsiatsky undertook a round-the-world tour with the purpose
of unification of various separate groups of Russian Fascisti
into one party. ' While in Japan, he had a conference with a
certain K. Rodzaevsky, representative of the Harbin Fascisti,
during the course of which an agreement was reached between them
regarding the amalgamation of their respective groups into one
party to be known in future as the "All-Russian Fascist Party".
    On April 10, 1934 Vonsiatsky arrived in Shanghai and
after ten days' stay in this city proceeded to Harbin, where he
was welcomed with a great pomp by the local Fascisti.    He was
then elected President of the Party, while Rodzaevsky was appointed
Secretary-General of the Party, the Central Executive Committee
of which was established in Harbin.    Returning to Shanghai after
three weeks' absence, Vonsiatsky delivered a lecture on the
Russian Fascist Movement at the Embassy Theatre on May 21 and left
for Europe on the following day.
    While in Shanghai, he endeavoured to establish a branch
of the All-Russian Fascist Party here, but the interest, which
his arrival undoubtedly aroused among local Russians, soon died
away owing to the general disappointment in his personality as
a leader, as well as to his haphazard manner of carrying out his
mission.    The only practical result of his visit to Shanghai
was the formation of several groups of Fascist sympathisers who,
not being unified into one body, recognize the Harbin Executive
Committee as their centre.    With the exception of holding one
or two public lectures their activity in Shanghai has since been
limited to distribution of the Fascist literature and the "Nash Put",
which became the central organ of the All-Russian Fascist Party.

1934年，冯夏茨基进行了一次环球旅行，目的是将各个分散的俄罗斯法西斯主义团体统一为一个政党。在日本期间，他与哈尔滨法西斯主义者的代表K. 罗扎耶夫斯基（K. Rodzaevsky）举行了会议，在此期间，双方就将其各自的团体合并为一个政党达成协议，该党今后将被称为“全俄法西斯党”。
    1934年4月10日，冯夏茨基抵达上海，在该市停留十天后前往哈尔滨，当地法西斯主义者以盛大的排场欢迎他。随后他当选为党主席，而罗扎耶夫斯基被任命为党的总书记，党的中央执行委员会设在哈尔滨。离开三周后回到上海，冯夏茨基于5月21日在爱姆倍影戏院（Embassy Theatre）发表了关于俄罗斯法西斯运动的演讲，并于次日前往欧洲。
    在上海期间，他试图在此建立全俄法西斯党的分部，但他的到来无疑在当地俄罗斯人中激起的兴趣很快便消退了，原因是人们对他作为领导人的个性普遍感到失望，以及他执行使命的方式杂乱无章。他访问上海的唯一实际成果是形成了几个法西斯同情者小组，这些小组没有统一为一个整体，承认哈尔滨执行委员会为其中心。除了举行一两次公开讲座外，他们在上海的活动此后仅限于分发法西斯文献和《我们的道路》（"Nash Put"），后者已成为全俄法西斯党的中央机关报。

APPENDIX " A "

Translation of letter dated May 9, 1934, Dairen, addressed
by Ataman Semenoff to the Editor of the Shanghai "SLOVO",
which appears in the "FASCIST" of June-July, 1934 (No. 11).

Dear Sir,

I sincerely regret to see our youth being carried away
by Fascism and Hitler's National-Socialism to a degree when
some hot-heads among them forget the true interests of our
Motherland for the sake of these foreign and impracticable
in Russia doctrines.

The atmosphere of noisy publicity and self-praise
surrounding Vonsiatsky's trip, is very much responsible for
this regrettable state of affairs and, therefore, I deem it
necessary to publish the enclosed article in order to check
our over-zealous young politicians.

I ask you to publish the enclosed article in your
esteemed journal, because I deem it necessary and expedient
to remind our youth of their true duties to our Motherland
and to warn them against an undue enthusiasm over fashionable
political doctrines, which are absolutely of no use to us.

Yours respectfully,
(Signed) G. Semenoff.

P.S. Vonsiatsky was asked to leave Manchukuo because of his
noisy propaganda and publicity, which sometimes smells
of provocation. I was forced to refuse him an
interview on his way back to Shanghai.
(Signed) S.

Translator's Note: "SLOVO" did not publish the above letter and the
article to which reference is made in it.
pages.zh:
附录 “ A ”

1934年5月9日于大连发出的信件译文，由阿塔曼·谢苗诺夫致上海《言论报》编辑，该信刊登于1934年6-7月（第11期）的《法西斯主义者》上。

尊敬的先生：

我真诚地遗憾看到我们的青年被法西斯主义和希特勒的国家社会主义所迷醉，以至于他们中的一些头脑发热者为了这些在俄罗斯行不通的外国教条而忘记了祖国的真正利益。

围绕冯夏茨基之行的喧闹宣传和自我吹嘘的气氛，对这种令人遗憾的局面负有很大责任，因此，我认为有必要发表所附文章，以遏制我们那些过于热情的年轻政客。

我请求您在贵刊发表所附文章，因为我认为有必要且适宜提醒我们的青年铭记他们对祖国的真正义务，并警告他们不要对时尚的政治教条产生过度的热情，这些教条对我们绝对毫无用处。

此致
敬礼，
（签名）G. 谢苗诺夫（G. Semenoff）。

附言：冯夏茨基因其喧闹的宣传和 publicity，有时带有挑衅意味，被要求离开伪满洲国。在他返回上海途中，我被迫拒绝与他面谈。
（签名）S.

pages.en:
APPENDIX "B"

Translation of article which appears in No. 11
of "THE FASCIST" on the subject of Ataman Semenoff.

VILE PROVOCATION AND SLANDER OF "ATAMAN" SEMENOFF

In reply to grandiose demonstrations staged by the
Russian Fascists in Harbin ambitious intriguers of the
type of "Ataman" Semenoff intensify their attacks on the
All-Russian Fascist Party. Below we reproduce a
photographic copy of a letter addressed by "The Ataman"
to the Editor of the Shanghai newspaper "Slovo". This
letter bears the stamp of base and vile calumny and is
a worthy instrument of his criminal obstruction and
sabotage.

"Ataman" Semenoff is worrying about the "true
interests" of "our Motherland", which are threatened
by the fact of our youth being attracted by "political
doctrines impracticable in Russia." In reality, however,
The "Ataman" is worried by the fact that, while he is
finished as an active political personage, the rapid
progress of the Russian Fascism astonishes the whole
world.

The spectacle of unheard of rapidity of expansion of the
Russian Fascist Movement, as contrasted with the growing
decay of Communism, frightens all ex- "Atamans" and is
the cause of their impotent barking at the All-Russian
Fascist Party on the pages of obscure emigrant newspapers.
The All Russian Fascist Party recruits more and more new
members and Messrs. Semenoff & Co. cannot deny this fact.
It is not within their power to prevent the Russian
Fascism from marching victoriously ahead.

"Ataman's " letter is an act of obstruction and
sabotage with a view to compromising successes of the
Russian Fascist movement in the Far East.

Russian Fascisti must reply to this stupid and criminal
provocation by the mobilization of all their forces under
the slogan: "GET OUT OF THE WAY, ALL "ATAMANS";-FASCISTI
ARE COMING!"
pages.zh:
附录 “B”

《法西斯主义者》第11期上发表的关于阿塔曼·谢苗诺夫的文章译文。

“阿塔曼”谢苗诺夫的卑鄙挑衅与诽谤

针对俄罗斯法西斯主义者在哈尔滨举行的盛大示威，像“阿塔曼”谢苗诺夫这类野心勃勃的阴谋家加紧了对全俄法西斯党的攻击。下面我们转载了一封由“阿塔曼”致上海报纸《言论报》编辑的信件的摄影副本。这封信打上了卑鄙和恶毒诽谤的烙印，是他进行犯罪阻挠和破坏的得力工具。

“阿塔曼”谢苗诺夫担心“我们祖国”的“真正利益”，因为这些利益受到我们的青年被“在俄罗斯行不通的政治教条”所吸引这一事实的威胁。然而实际上，“阿塔曼”担心的是，当他作为一个活跃的政治人物已经完结时，俄罗斯法西斯主义的迅速进步震惊了全世界。

与共产主义日益衰败形成对比的是，俄罗斯法西斯运动以前所未有的速度扩张的景象，吓坏了所有前“阿塔曼”，并导致他们在晦涩难懂的侨民报纸页面上对全俄法西斯党发出无能的狂吠。全俄法西斯党招募的新成员越来越多，谢苗诺夫及其同伙无法否认这一事实。他们无力阻止俄罗斯法西斯主义胜利前进。

“阿塔曼”的信是一种阻挠和破坏行为，旨在损害俄罗斯法西斯运动在远东的成功。

俄罗斯法西斯主义者必须在“所有‘阿塔曼’让路；——法西斯主义者来了！”的口号下动员全部力量，以回应这种愚蠢和犯罪的挑衅。

pages.en:
APPENDIX "C"

Translation of article which appears in No. 13 of
"The Fascist" dated November, 1934.

BLOW OUT THE TRAITOR'S BRAINS

With greatest indignation I read in "The Fascist"
the letter of the notorious "Ataman" Semenoff.

Our leader and fellow-member Vonsiatsky carries
on the struggle against the bolsheviks in an energetic and
forceful manner, and combined efforts of all agents-provocateurs
of the type of "Ataman" Semenoff cannot weaken our struggle.
In volume V of the "White Cause", General Wrangel wrote
that in 1916, while he was the Commander of the Nerchinsky
Regiment of the Ussury Cossack Division, Cossack Lieutenant
Semenoff was in command of the 6th squadron of the Regiment.
Semenoff passed with difficulty the final examinations in
a military school. He was inclined to intrigues and was
most unscrupulous in means he used for attaining his aims.
He used to make a show of his "bravery" before higher
commanders.

In 1918 Admiral Kolchak's appearance in Siberia
put an end to ambitious plans of Semenoff who at that time
was active in the Eastern Siberia. The cossack lieutenant
regarded the patriotic activities of Admiral Kolchak as
an "encroachment on his rights" and therefore refused to
recognize the Admiral as the Supreme Ruler. Kolchak then
ordered Semenoff to be court-martialled.

Semenoff commenced to intercept goods in transportation
from Vladivostock for the Siberian Army, threatening to cut
the army off the Maritime province.

At the same time, looking for support, Semenoff
appealed to Dutoff, Ataman of Orenbourg Cossack Troops,
but the latter refused to co-operate with him. Semenoff

1934年11月出版的《法西斯主义者》第13期上发表的文章译文。

击碎叛徒的脑袋

我怀着极大的愤慨在《法西斯主义者》上读到了臭名昭著的“阿塔曼”谢苗诺夫的来信。

我们的领袖和同志冯夏茨基以精力充沛和有力的方式开展反对布尔什维克的斗争，像“阿塔曼”谢苗诺夫这类代理人-挑衅者的共同努力无法削弱我们的斗争。在《白军事业》（"White Cause"）第五卷中，弗兰格尔将军写道，1916年，当他担任乌苏里哥萨克师涅尔琴斯克团团长时，哥萨克中尉谢苗诺夫指挥该团的第6中队。谢苗诺夫勉强通过了军事学校的毕业考试。他倾向于搞阴谋诡计，在为实现目标所使用的手段上最不择手段。他常常在高级指挥官面前炫耀他的“勇敢”。

1918年，高尔察克海军上将出现在西伯利亚，终结了当时在西伯利亚东部活跃的谢苗诺夫的野心计划。这位哥萨克中尉将高尔察克海军上将的爱国活动视为“侵犯他的权利”，因此拒绝承认海军上将为最高统治者。随后，高尔察克命令对谢苗诺夫进行军事法庭审判。

谢苗诺夫开始拦截从符拉迪沃斯托克运往西伯利亚军队的物资，威胁要切断军队与滨海省的联系。

与此同时，为了寻求支持，谢苗诺夫向奥伦堡哥萨克部队阿塔曼杜托夫（Dutoff）求助，但后者拒绝与他合作。谢苗诺夫

then approached General Denikin. However, General
Wrangel together with Denikin expressed in strong terms
his indignation over Semenoff's attitude and sent to him
the following telegram: "Up to the present time I was
proud of having been commander of the glorious Nerchinsky
Regiment, but now I am ashamed that one of its members
proved to be a traitor of the common cause".
The entire party must unanimously brand with
despise the dirty bolshevist propaganda of Ataman-adventurer
and highway bandit Semenoff, whom General Wrangel, our
valiant Commander-in-Chief, branded with the name of traitor
of the sacred cause of salvation of Russia.

全党必须一致鄙弃阿塔曼冒险家兼公路强盗谢苗诺夫那肮脏的布尔什维克宣传，我们英勇的总司令弗兰格尔将军已将其定性为俄罗斯神圣救赎事业的叛徒。

Translation of article which appeared in the "SLOVO" of

A.A. VONSIATZKY EXPELLED FROM THE FASCIST PARTY

On December 11 decision of the central organ of the
Fascist Party became known, by which A.A. Vonsiatzky was expelled
from the Party. This decision was taken during the course
of an extraordinary meeting of the Central Committee of the
party after an understanding had been reached on the subject
with various branches of the party abroad.

A.A. Vonsiatzky was first deprived of the title of
President of the All-Russian Fascist Party, whereupon a special
order was passed regarding his exclusion from the ranks of the
party.

Vonsiatzky's recent attack in his personal journal
entitled "FASCIST" on Ataman G.M. Semenoff, which was made
inspite repeated warnings on the part of the Central Executive
Committee of the party, was the immediate cause of his expulsion.

On December 11 our representative visited the Russian
Club. Portraits of Vonsiatzky had already been removed from
the main hall and other rooms of the club. Mr. K.V. Rodzaevsky,
interviewed regarding the reasons of expulsion of Vonsiatzky
from the party, stated:-

When electing A.A. Vonsiatzky on the post of President
of the party, the Central Executive Committee of the All-Russian
Fascist Party expected that he would develop anti-communist
struggle on a big scale, as he was in a position to do so. We
believed that he would facilitate the organization of a powerful
and active party unifying in its ranks all active elements
among Russian emigrants. We also expected a further development
of the national-revolutionary work in the USSR.

Vonsiatzky's activities were not in accord with the
above fundamental tasks. On the contrary, he did his utmost
in order to isolate the All-Russian Fascist Party from friendly

A.A. 冯夏茨基被开除出法西斯党

12月11日，法西斯党中央机构的一项决定为人所知，根据该决定，A.A. 冯夏茨基被开除出党。此项决定是在与海外各支部就该问题达成谅解后，于党中央委员会特别会议期间作出的。

A.A. 冯夏茨基首先被剥夺全俄法西斯党主席头衔，随后通过一项特别命令将其从党内除名。

冯夏茨基近期在其个人刊物《法西斯》上对阿塔曼 G.M. 谢苗诺夫发起攻击，尽管党中央执行委员会多次警告，他仍执意为之，这是导致其被开除的直接原因。

12月11日，我方代表访问了俄罗斯俱乐部。俱乐部主厅及其他房间内的冯夏茨基肖像已被移除。就冯夏茨基被开除出党的原因采访 K.V. 罗扎耶夫斯基先生时，他表示：-

在选举 A.A. 冯夏茨基担任党主席时，全俄法西斯党中央执行委员会期望他能大规模开展反共斗争，因为他具备这样做的条件。我们相信他将有助于组织一个强大且活跃的政党，将俄罗斯移民中的所有活跃分子团结在其队伍中。我们也期望在苏联境内进一步发展民族革命工作。

冯夏茨基的活动与上述基本任务不符。相反，他竭尽全力使全俄法西斯党与友好

pages.en:
- 2 -
organizations as well as from masses. In particular, he intended
to bring about a breach between us and the Far Eastern Cossacks'
Union, which unifies an overwhelming majority of cossacks in
the Far East.
Vonsiatzky's steps in that direction have long ago
aroused our criticism and opposition. But, when in the No. 11
issue of the "FASCIST", Vonsiatzky's personal organ, he published
articles openly attacking Ataman Semenoff, the Central Executive
Committee of the party wrote to Vonsiatzky, explaining in detail
the party's position and requested him to abstain in future from
such ill-considered acts. At the same time the Central Executive
Committee called upon Vonsiatzky, as a member of the party, to
abide by the decisions of the Committee and to rectify his
wrong-doings.
However, in the issue No. 13 of the "FASCIST", we again
find unpleasant news.
On the front page of this issue, under the headline,
Vonsiatzky without permission of the Central Executive Committee
inserted a line to the effect that the journal in question is
the "main organ of All-Russian Fascist Party". Apart from this,
an article appears in that issue of the journal under the
heading: "BLOW OUT THE TRAITOR'S BRAINS", which contains revolting
insinuations directed against Ataman Semenoff.
Taking into consideration the above facts and in view
of breach of party discipline by Vonsiatzky, the Central
Executive Committee decided to expel him from the ranks of the
party.
We are confident that the Third Congress of the party,
which will be held in June, 1935, will confirm our decision,
which was taken in view of very strange activities of Vonsiatzky
which threatened to cause serious obstructions to the party's
work.
D.S.S.A.
Information. ABR 2/12

组织以及群众隔离开来。特别是，他意图造成我们与远东哥萨克联盟之间的破裂，该联盟团结了远东绝大多数哥萨克人。
冯夏茨基在此方向上的举措早已引起我们的批评和反对。但是，当冯夏茨基的个人刊物《法西斯》第11期发表公开攻击阿塔曼谢苗诺夫的文章时，党中央执行委员会致信冯夏茨基，详细解释了党的立场，并要求他今后避免此类轻率行为。同时，党中央执行委员会呼吁冯夏茨基作为一名党员，遵守委员会的决定并纠正其错误行为。
然而，在《法西斯》第13期中，我们又看到了令人不快的消息。
在该期头版，标题之下，冯夏茨基未经党中央执行委员会许可，插入了一行文字，大意是该刊物是“全俄法西斯党的主要机关报”。此外，该期刊物中还刊登了一篇题为“轰掉叛徒的脑袋”的文章，其中包含针对阿塔曼谢苗诺夫的令人作呕的影射。
考虑到上述事实，鉴于冯夏茨基违反党纪，党中央执行委员会决定将其从党内除名。
我们确信，将于1935年6月举行的党的第三次代表大会将确认我们的决定，该决定是基于冯夏茨基非常奇怪的活动作出的，这些活动威胁到对党的工作造成严重阻碍。
D.S.S.A.
情报。 ABR 2/12

Sir,

I have the honour to apply for permission to hold, on
Saturday, July 28, 1934, in the house of Mr. G.O. Gogvadze,
Apart. 8, No. 171 Muirhead Road, a private meeting of members
of the Shanghai branch of All-Russia Fascist Party for the
purpose of celebration the Day of the Russian Orthodox Culture.
The celebration will be opened by a thanksgiving service
which will be followed by an address on the subject of the
"Predominant Ideas of History of the Russian State" delivered
by Mr. J.V. Galitzky in collaboration with Mr. D.G.Kadoshnikoff.
No announcements will be made in the local press regarding
the meeting and it will be a function of a purely scientific-
educational character as an outward sign of the spiritual unity
of members of All-Russia Fascist Party in the ranks of Russian
emigres on the Day of St. Vladimir - the annual holiday of the
Russian Fascist Party.
The celebration will be conducted in an orderly manner
and all pertaining Municipal regulations will be strictly
observed. Admittance for members and their guests will be
free.
The function will commence at 7 p.m. and will be over
by 12 midnight.
Mr. J.V. Galitzky will be responsible organiser of the
meeting.

(Signed) J. Galitzky,
Representative of All-Russia
Fascist Party in Shanghai.
July 23, 1934, Shanghai.

Lecture by A. A. Vonsiatsky

Yesterday it was definitely decided, that
the lecture of the leader of the Russian Fascists,
A. A. Vonsiatsky, will be delivered tomorrow,
Monday, May 21, at 7 p.m. in the premises of the
"Embassy Theatre", Bubbling Well Road.

The programme of the lecture is:
1) The tactics of the United Fascist Front.
2) The crisis of the communist system.
3) The growth of the revolutionary movement in
the U.S.S.R. (anti-bolshevik).
4) The growth of Russian Fascism.

Admittance to the lecture is free but only
on production of invitation cards. The tickets
issued for admission to the proposed lecture in
the premises of the "Shanghai Mainichi" are
available for the lecture tomorrow.

演讲节目如下：
1) 联合法西斯阵线的策略。
2) 共产主义制度的危机。
3) 苏联革命运动的增长（反布尔什维克）。
4) 俄国法西斯主义的增长。

演讲免费入场，但须出示邀请卡。此前为拟在上海《每日新闻》（Shanghai Mainichi）社址举行的演讲所发行的入场券，可用于明日的演讲。

Translation of an article re Vonsiatsky published in the
Russian newspaper "Vechernia Zaria" on May 22, 1934. 3 / 31L

VONSIATSKY REPRESENTED AS A FREE-MASON:
STRANGE TELEGRAM FROM SINZIN.

On May 20 the "Harbin Times", a Japanese newspaper
published in the Russian language, published the following
telegram from Sinzin (Changchunng), the capital of Manchukuo,
under the sensational headings:- "Vonsiatsky, leader of
fascists - a free mason".

Sinzin, May 18 (Kokuzu). - A. A. Vonsiatsky, who
calls himself the leader of the All-Russian Fascist Party,
and who arrived in Harbin from Shanghai on April 26, under
the pretext of organizing a Russian Fascist movement in
Manchu-Di-Kuo, spent about 10 days in organization work.
In well informed local circles it is said that Vonsiatsky
knows nothing about fascist ideas and that his real object
is to appease the anti-semitic and free-mason movement
which recently started all over the world.

The cause of the opposition to Vonsiatsky came through
his criticism of the anti-Jewish movement on the part of
Harbin Fascist led by Rodzaevsky. There is no doubt that
someone is stubbornly carrying on the provocative work in
Japanese circles, misleading even such a well informed news
agency as the Kokuzu.

冯西亚茨基被描绘为共济会会员：
来自新京的奇怪电报。

5月20日，用俄文出版的日本报纸《哈尔滨时报》在耸人听闻的标题下刊登了以下来自满洲国首都新京（长春）的电报：“法西斯领袖冯西亚茨基——一名共济会会员”。

新京，5月18日（国粹社）。- 自称全俄法西斯党领袖的 A. A. 冯西亚茨基于4月26日从上海抵达哈尔滨，借口在满洲帝国组织俄国法西斯运动，进行了约10天的组织工作。据当地消息灵通人士称，冯西亚茨基对法西斯思想一无所知，其真实目的是安抚最近在世界范围内兴起的反犹太主义和共济会运动。

反对冯西亚茨基的原因在于他批评了由罗扎耶夫斯基（Rodzaevsky）领导的哈尔滨法西斯派的反犹太运动。毫无疑问，有人在日本圈子中顽固地进行挑衅工作，甚至误导了像国粹社这样消息灵通的通讯社。
