（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. R. C. I. D.
No. D 5835
Date 27 / 5 / 34）

Translation of an article appearing the "Slov" of May 28, 1934.

A. A. VONSIATSKY'S LECTURE.

At 7 p.m. May 21 the Embassy Theatre was already filled
to capacity. However, to the disappointment of the public the
proceedings did not commence until 7.30 p.m. The lecture was
expected with keen interest and was attended by representatives
of almost all Russian organizations as well as members of the
younger generation.

— • —

The senior group of the Russian Boy-scouts in uniform
assisted; they were easily recognizable by their special
rhombus-shaped, white metal badges inscribed with the swastika
in the centre and with the double-headed eagle emblem in the
upper corner. Order was maintained in an efficient manner.

After giving a fascist salute to the audience, Vonsiatsky,
in a few introductory remarks, stated that he desired to acquaint
the active elements of Russian emigres with the principles of the
Russian Fascist Movement. He pointed out that the subject of
his address would be the All-Russian Fascist Party, the formation
of which, after the unification of Russian Fascists in the U.S.A.,
Europe and the Far East, was an accomplished fact.

Vonsiatsky's address was divided into the following heads:
The United Tactics of the Fascist Front. - The crisis in the
Communist System. - The growing intensity of the revolutionary
spirit in the U.S.S.R. - The growth of Russian Fascism.

Referring to the triumphant successes of the Fascism in
all countries, the speaker expressed the hope that the Fascist
movement would arouse the keenest interest and become a subject
of discussion among the emigres.

He then dwelt upon the importance of organization in any
political movement and declared that the All-Russian Fascist
Party had worked out an excellent plan of political organization
among the Russian emigres.
pages.zh:
（印章：上海公共租界警务处
S. S. R. C. I. D.
编号 D 5835
日期 1934年5月27日）

翻译自1934年5月28日《斯洛沃》报上刊登的文章。

A. A. 冯西亚茨基的演讲。

5月21日晚上7点，大使剧院已经座无虚席。然而，令公众失望的是，活动直到晚上7点半才开始。人们对此次演讲寄予厚望，几乎所有俄国组织的代表以及年轻一代的成员都出席了。

— • —

身着制服的俄国童子军高级组提供了协助；他们很容易通过特殊的菱形白金属徽章被识别出来，徽章中央刻有卐字，左上角刻有双头鹰徽记。现场秩序维持得当。

冯西亚茨基向观众行法西斯礼后，在简短的开场白中表示，他希望让俄国侨民中的活跃分子了解俄国法西斯运动的原则。他指出，他的演讲主题是全俄法西斯党，该党在美国、欧洲和远东的俄国法西斯主义者统一之后，成立已成为既定事实。

冯西亚茨基的演讲分为以下几个部分：
法西斯阵线的联合策略。- 共产主义制度的危机。- 苏联革命精神日益高涨。- 俄国法西斯主义的增长。

谈到法西斯主义在所有国家取得的辉煌成功，演讲者希望法西斯运动能引起侨民们的极大兴趣并成为讨论的话题。

接着，他阐述了组织在任何政治运动中的重要性，并宣称全俄法西斯党已在俄国侨民中制定了出色的政治组织计划。

pages.en:
- 2 -

To our regret the speaker was very brief on this subject;
he said nothing regarding the advantages to be derived from the
fascist organization nor did he touch upon the subject of the
ideology of the fascist movement. Thus there was lack of
cohesion between the theses he had attempted to develop in the
course of the address. To the non-fascist members of the audience
the lecture was not convincing.

Dealing with fascist tactics, the speaker emphasised the
immense importance of propaganda among the workers and peasants
in the U.S.S.R. with a view to organizing a general uprising of
the population. In his opinion, the success of this work will
depend on the happy selection of slogans, such as: "Division of
-owned
collectively/farms", "All land to be divided amongst farmers",
"Normal working conditions". Unfortunately, the speaker said
nothing regarding the possibility, under present conditions in
the U.S.S.R., of organizing such an extensive movement in that
country. Apart from expressing his opinion - which nobody
disputes - that the U.S.S.R. Government is bitterly hated by
the people, the speaker had nothing further to say on the subject
of fascist tactics. The audience listened to this particular
part of the address with great attention but they were unable to
get a clear understanding of the speaker's ideas owing to his
method of lecturing.

It is very much to be regretted that the speaker did not
take into consideration the fact that the audience knew almost
nothing of fascist doctrines and did not go into the matter in
a more detailed manner. The same remark applies to that part
of the lecture dealing with the crisis in the communist party.
The well known preceding of economic, social and political
order is causing a crisis in the Soviet system of government
and the communism throughout the whole world - not excluding
the U.S.S.R. itself. All these facts were not sufficiently
dealt with by the speaker.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

令人遗憾的是，演讲者在这一主题上讲得非常简略；他没有提及从法西斯组织中可以获得的好处，也没有触及法西斯运动的意识形态主题。因此，他在演讲过程中试图展开的论点之间缺乏连贯性。对于观众中的非法西斯成员来说，这次演讲缺乏说服力。

在论述法西斯策略时，演讲者强调了在苏联工人和农民中进行宣传以组织全民起义的巨大重要性。他认为，这项工作的成功将取决于口号的正确选择，例如：“集体农庄的分割”、“土地全部分配给农民”、“正常的工作条件”。不幸的是，演讲者没有谈及在苏联当前条件下在该国组织如此大规模运动的可能性。除了表达无人争议的观点——即苏联政府深受人民痛恨之外，演讲者在法西斯策略主题上没有更多阐述。观众非常 attentively 地聆听了演讲的这一部分，但由于演讲者的授课方式，他们无法清晰理解演讲者的思路。

非常遗憾的是，演讲者没有考虑到观众对法西斯学说几乎一无所知的事实，也没有更详细地深入探讨这一问题。同样的评论也适用于演讲中涉及共产党危机的部分。众所周知，经济、社会和政治秩序的先行状况正在导致苏维埃政府体制以及全世界（包括苏联本身）的共产主义出现危机。演讲者未能充分阐述所有这些事实。

pages.en:
- 3 -

One should be particularly careful when speaking of the growing revolutionary spirit in the U.S.S.R. There is no doubt that, psychosocially, the country is ripe for revolution, but organization and action are necessary in order to transform this into a revolutionary uprising. The speaker did not discuss this point at all. To the mass of Russian emigres, however, it is a matter of a tremendous import, because an overwhelming majority of these Russian emigrants is firmly convinced that only a blow from outside, as for example, in the event of an armed conflict with another, will provide the enslaved population of the U.S.S.R. an opportunity to give tangible expression to its revolutionary spirit. That this revolutionary spirit does exist in the U.S.S.R. nobody can deny.

As regards the growth of Russian fascism, the speaker made reference to the activities of the Russian fascist organizations in America, Europe and the Far East. Again it is to be regretted that the speaker failed to explain, from the point of view of the All-Russian Fascist Party, the difference between that party and the "MLADOROSSY" (Neo-Russians) who declare that they are the Russian fascists, and the "Russ-Nazi" who think of a State based on the principles of religion and nationalism.

Apart from these few criticisms, we have to admit that Mr. A.A.Vonsiatsky's address, which was made from, no doubt, sincerely patriotic enthusiasm was a novelty to the Russian community in Shanghai. It tended to awaken active political thought; it inculcated a sense of sacrifice and attracted the attention of the Russian emigres to a great movement of world-wide significance known under different names in various countries, but which, everywhere, may be designated under the common appellation of "Fascism".

As this, according to the introductory remarks of the lecturer, was his intention, he has admirably succeeded.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

在谈论苏联日益增长的革命精神时应格外谨慎。毫无疑问，从社会心理角度来看，该国已具备革命条件，但需要组织和行动才能将其转化为革命起义。演讲者完全没有讨论这一点。然而，对于广大俄国侨民来说，这是一个极其重要的问题，因为绝大多数俄国侨民坚信，只有来自外部的打击，例如在与另一国发生武装冲突的情况下，才能为苏联被奴役的人口提供具体表达其革命精神的机会。没有人能否认苏联确实存在这种革命精神。

关于俄国法西斯主义的增长，演讲者提到了美国、欧洲和远东的俄国法西斯组织的活动。再次令人遗憾的是，演讲者未能从全俄法西斯党的角度解释该党与声称自己是俄国法西斯主义者的“青年俄罗斯”（MLADOROSSY，即新俄罗斯人）以及主张建立基于宗教和民族主义原则国家的“俄纳粹”（Russ-Nazi）之间的区别。

除了这几点点评，我们必须承认，A.A.冯西亚茨基先生的演讲无疑出于真诚的爱国热情，对上海的俄国社区来说是一件新鲜事。它倾向于唤醒积极的政治思考；灌输牺牲精神，并将俄国侨民的注意力吸引到一个具有世界意义的伟大运动上，该运动在不同国家有不同的名称，但在各地均可统称为“法西斯主义”。

根据演讲者的开场白，这既是他的意图，他也出色地实现了这一目标。

We must, however, point out that it is impossible to
cover effectively a subject of such importance and magnitude
in a lecture lasting but sixty minutes.
pages.zh:
- 4 -

然而，我们必须指出，在仅持续六十分钟的演讲中，不可能有效地涵盖如此重要和宏大的主题。

Translation of an article appearing in the "Kopeika" of
May 22, 1934.

"BENEFACTOR" FROM AMERICA.
VONSIATSKY'S HOPELESS FAILURE AS A "LEADER".

At 7 p.m. yesterday a feeble address was delivered
at the Embassy Theatre by Mr. A. Vonsiatsky, who claims
to be the leader of the Russian Fascist movement. The
address was intended to furnish general information on
the subject of the movement.

Well, one can only say that a "big mountain has given
birth to a small mouse". The "leader" of the Russian
Fascism made a public appearance and gave a complete
exhibition of his incompetence. It was childish; more-
over, it bore the stamp of ignorance. In the course of
one whole hour, amidst dead silence on the part of the
audience, a man of narrow mind and low intelligence, with
painted eyebrows and the mannerism of a provincial actor,
was mouthing commonplaces.

Instead of the clear-cut and finished ideology, typical
of the Fascism, the Russian emigrants who gathered at the
Embassy Theatre were treated to an assortment of out-of-
date cries and slogans of which one has been ti..ed long
ago.

"The Russian Fascist Party", Vonsiatsky said, "is a
party of struggle".

But not a word was said regarding the struggle, the
party itself or its programme.

He stated that terror reigns in Russia, that workers
are dissatisfied, that anti-communist feelings is growing
among the peasantry, that masses of the proletarian are to
be organized. But how are they to be organized?

It would seem that an answer to this elementary
question might be furnished by an individual claiming
pages.zh:
译自1934年5月22日《戈比报》（Kopeika）刊登的一篇文章。

来自美国的“恩人”。
冯西亚茨基作为“领袖”的彻底失败。

昨晚7时，自称俄罗斯法西斯运动领袖的A. 冯西亚茨基先生（Mr. A. Vonsiatsky）在大使剧院（Embassy Theatre）发表了一篇软弱无力的演讲。该演讲旨在提供关于该运动的一般性信息。

嗯，只能说这是“大山产小鼠”。这位俄罗斯法西斯主义的“领袖”公开露面，充分展示了他能力的欠缺。这显得幼稚；此外，还打上了无知的烙印。在整整一个小时里，听众死一般寂静，一个心胸狭窄、智力低下、画着眉毛、带着外省演员习气的人，正在喋喋不休地陈词滥调。

聚集在大使剧院的俄罗斯流亡者原本期待听到法西斯主义典型的清晰且完整的意识形态，结果听到的却是一堆过时的、人们早已听腻的叫喊和口号的大杂烩。

冯西亚茨基说：“俄罗斯法西斯党是一个斗争的政党”。

但他只字未提关于斗争、政党本身或其纲领的内容。

他声称恐怖统治笼罩着俄罗斯，工人不满，农民中反共情绪日益增长，必须组织起广大无产阶级群众。但是如何组织他们呢？

看来，对这个基本问题的回答本应由一位自称

to be a leader, the head of the Russian Fascism.
Vonsiatsky failed to give the expected answer.
Impressions?
The theatre was crowded. All the prominent
members of the local Russian emigrants were present.
Boy-scouts, (who had been drawn into this political
farce through lack of tact on the part of their
instructors), maintained general order.
The function was set for 7 p.m., but Vonsiatsky,
a true follower of American tactics, kept the public
waiting till half past seven. Punctuality is the
politeness of Kings. Vonsiatsky could have had nothing
to do with Kings. Or......
Remarks amongst the audience.
"It is about time to start, eh? Is he busy with
his 'make up' according to his habit?"
"Yes. Fascism is organization and punctuality".
"Oh, what is the use of quoting Mussolini?
Vonsiatsky himself is his own Hitler".
The public begins to show signs of impatience.
Follows stamping of feet with clapping of hands.
The curtain goes up. The lights go out. The
stage is decorated with two Russian national flags.
A tribune is also draped in Russian national colours.
There is a table with a decanter of water and a glass.
Enters Vonsiatsky --- marching smartly as becomes
a genuine Fascist. Applause. With a theatrical gesture
he calls for silence. The applause ceases obediently
and the abracadabra commences.
The purpose of the address was, according to the
speaker, to enable those who do not belong to the Russian
Fascist Party, to get acquainted with this party.
A summary of newspaper reports on the situation
in the U.S.S.R. is given.

是领袖、俄罗斯法西斯主义头目的人来提供。
冯西亚茨基未能给出预期的回答。
印象如何？
剧院座无虚席。当地俄罗斯流亡者的所有知名成员均出席。
童子军（由于指导者缺乏策略而被卷入这场政治闹剧）维持着现场秩序。
活动定于晚上7点开始，但冯西亚茨基作为美国战术的忠实追随者，让公众一直等到七点半。守时是国王的礼貌。冯西亚茨基与国王毫无关系。或者……
听众中的议论。
“该开始了吧，嗯？他是不是像往常一样忙着‘化妆’？”
“是的。法西斯主义就是组织和守时”。
“哦，引用墨索里尼有什么用？冯西亚茨基自己就是他自己的希特勒”。
公众开始表现出不耐烦的迹象。
接着是跺脚和拍手声。
幕布升起。灯光熄灭。舞台上装饰着两面俄罗斯国旗。
讲台也披挂着俄罗斯国旗颜色的饰布。
桌上放着一个水瓶和一个玻璃杯。
冯西亚茨基入场——步伐矫健，符合一个真正法西斯分子的身份。掌声。他以戏剧性的手势要求安静。掌声顺从地停止，胡言乱语开始了。
据演讲者称，演讲的目的是让那些不属于俄罗斯法西斯党的人了解该党。
他对有关苏联局势的报纸报道进行了摘要介绍。

Why the dissatisfaction in the U.S.S.R. should
take the form of a Fascist Revolution, the speaker
failed to explain.
Non-recognition of any "Hierarchy" was stated
to be the main foundation of Fascism and its success.
"All active elements are with us!" exclaimed
the "leader".
But in the name of......what? For, this is a
matter where beautiful eyes alone count for nothing.
Remarks among the public:-
"Is it possible that he has not read a single
booklet on the Fascist movement? He should have read
one in order not to lose face in the presence of people".
The farcical address terminated with the shouting
of the slogan "Long live Fascist Russia".
"With a monarch at the head", added a firm voice
from among the audience.
Vonsiatsky raises his arm and writes the Fascist
greetings: "Glory to Russia". These constitute the only
words of value he has uttered in the course of his
address. He disappears from the stage.
Curtain.
No discussion, of course. In this respect the
"leader did not over-estimate his abilities".
Thus, all the noise raised around this political
upstart has come to naught.
We have stated that we had not the audacity of
recommending Mr. Vonsiatsky to Russian emigrants. We
even went so far as to declare that information at hand
regarding this individual did not warrant his being
taken more or less seriously. We did nothing to obstruct
the local newspaper campaign in favour of Vonsiatsky, as
only reliable and unimpeachable data could have justified
such an obstruction in respect of a person who had

演讲者未能解释为什么苏联的不满应采取法西斯革命的形式。
他声称，不承认任何“等级制度”是法西斯主义及其成功的主要基础。
“所有活跃分子都与我们在一起！”这位“领袖”惊呼道。
但是以……什么的名义？因为，这是一个光靠漂亮眼睛不起作用的问题。
公众中的议论：
“难道他连一本关于法西斯运动的小册子都没读过吗？他应该读一本，以免在人前丢脸”。
这场闹剧般的演讲以高呼“法西斯俄罗斯万岁”的口号结束。
“由一位君主领导”，观众中传来一个坚定的声音补充道。
冯西亚茨基举起手臂，写做法西斯式的问候语：“荣耀归于俄罗斯”。这是他演讲过程中所说的唯一有价值的话。他从舞台上消失。
幕落。
当然没有讨论环节。在这方面，这位“领袖”并没有高估自己的能力”。
因此，围绕这个政治暴发户掀起的所有喧嚣都化为乌有。
我们要指出，我们没有胆量向俄罗斯流亡者推荐冯西亚茨基先生。我们甚至宣称，手头关于此人的资料不足以证明他值得被或多或少地认真对待。我们没有阻碍当地报纸支持冯西亚茨基的宣传运动，因为只有可靠且无可指责的数据才能证明对一位宣称

Translation of an article appearing in the "Shanghai
Zaria" of May 22, 1934.

Mr. A.A. Vonsiatsky's Speech

Last night at 7.30 p.m. Mr. A. A. Vonsiatsky
delivered a speech in The Embassy Theatre on the
problems and aims of the All-Russian Fascist Party.
The theatre was packed and many important representatives
of local societies were present namely:- Mr. K. E.
Metsler- president of the Emigrants Committee; Doctor
D. I. Kazakoff; Mr. M. V. Olsufieff; Engineer A. G.
Chileunovski; Admiral Feodorovitch, president of the
Invalids' Union; General Zeemin; Mr. G. G. Sunnerberg;
Mr. M. G. Yakovkin and others.

When the curtain was drawn aside and the electric
light was switched off, Mr. A. A. Vonsiatsky appeared
on the stage in the limelight against the screen which
was draped with two national flags. Mr. Vonsiatsky
dwelt for some length on the crisis through which
Communism is at present passing and referred to "Nep"
(New Economic Policy)having succeeded military communism,
which former subsequently gave way to Stalin's
Pietyleka (Five Years' economic plan), the failure of
which inevitably shattered the structure of the
Communist Power. Nevertheless, one must not close
one's eyes to the fact that Communism is maintained not
only by terror, but also by the influence which it retains
over the labouring masses. The liberation of the
people from this influence, in the opinion of the
Speaker, is the chief aim of the All Russian Fascist Party.
In order to attain this, it will be necessary first of
all to find a proper approach to the masses of the
population. The search for this approach represents
the chief turning point in the tactics of the Fascist
Party.

译自1934年5月22日《上海霞报》（Shanghai Zaria）刊登的一篇文章。

A.A. 冯西亚茨基先生的演讲

昨晚7时30分，A. A. 冯西亚茨基先生在大使剧院就全俄法西斯党的问题和目标发表了演讲。
剧院挤满了人，许多当地社团的重要代表出席， namely:- K. E. 梅茨勒先生（Mr. K. E. Metsler）——流亡者委员会主席；D. I. 卡扎科夫医生（Doctor D. I. Kazakoff）；M. V. 奥尔苏菲耶夫先生（Mr. M. V. Olsufieff）；A. G. 奇列诺夫斯基工程师（Engineer A. G. Chileunovski）；费奥多罗维奇海军上将（Admiral Feodorovitch），伤残军人联盟主席；泽明将军（General Zeemin）；G. G. 孙纳伯格先生（Mr. G. G. Sunnerberg）；M. G. 亚科夫金先生（Mr. M. G. Yakovkin）及其他人士。

当幕布拉开，电灯关闭时，A. A. 冯西亚茨基先生出现在聚光灯下的舞台上，背景屏幕上悬挂着两面国旗。冯西亚茨基先生详细阐述了共产主义目前正经历的危机，并提到“新经济政策”（Nep）取代了军事共产主义，而前者随后又被斯大林的五年计划（Pietyleka）所取代，其失败不可避免地动摇了共产主义政权的结构。然而，人们不能无视这样一个事实：共产主义的维持不仅依靠恐怖，还依靠它对劳动群众保留的影响力。演讲者认为，将人民从这种影响中解放出来是全俄法西斯党的主要目标。为了实现这一目标，首先必须找到接近广大民众的适当途径。寻找这种途径代表了法西斯党策略的主要转折点。

The civil war stopped not because the White
Army was worn out, but because its leaders understood
their idealism was incomprehensible to the people.
We must approach the people with slogans which are
comprehensible to them and which they could follow.
The wall which U.S.S.R. has built shutting out the
entire world must be rammed not only from outside as
was done formerly, but chiefly from the inside.
Russian fascism has acquired great success
during recent years, Mr. Vonsiatsky claimed, and this
is even admitted by our enemies. The Fascist Party
is powerful chiefly because it is supported by the
broad masses of the people because all "the scale of
ranks" are completely eliminated from Fascist idealism.
We are working at present preparing staffs abroad,
ready at the first call, to be commissioned to the
assistance of our brethern in Russia and we are
convinced that officers of the White Army will join
our ranks, as well as all kinds of specialists and
qualified workers.
Soviet Russia is dying and we must replace
the Communist arbitrary regime and communist
dictatorship with Fascist dictatorship.
The speaker was given a hearty applause at the
termination of his speech.
Mr. A. A. Vonsiatsky, his wife and secretary -
Mr. D. I. Kunle went on board the steamer last night
which sails from Shanghai at daybreak to-day.
He intends to visit various countries in Europe
during the summer and will return to America in the
fall.

内战停止并不是因为白军筋疲力尽，而是因为其领导人明白他们的理想主义不被人民所理解。
我们必须用人民能理解并能追随的口号去接近人民。
苏联建立的隔绝整个世界的围墙，不仅必须像以前那样从外部撞击，而且主要从内部撞击。
冯西亚茨基先生声称，俄罗斯法西斯主义近年来取得了巨大成功，甚至连我们的敌人也承认这一点。法西斯党之所以强大，主要是因为它得到广大民众的支持，因为法西斯主义理想完全消除了所有“等级阶层”。
我们目前正在国外准备参谋人员，随时待命，一经召唤即可受命协助我们在俄罗斯的兄弟，我们确信白军军官以及各种专家和技术工人将加入我们的行列。
苏维埃俄罗斯正在消亡，我们必须用法西斯独裁取代共产主义的专制统治和共产主义独裁。
演讲结束时，演讲者获得了热烈的掌声。
A. A. 冯西亚茨基先生、他的妻子和秘书——D. I. 昆勒先生（Mr. D. I. Kunle）于昨晚登上轮船，该船将于今天黎明从上海启航。
他打算在夏季访问欧洲各国，并将于秋季返回美国。

CUTTING FROM THE SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY OF MAY 15, 1934
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. R. P. A. C. T.
No. D - 3832
Date 27 / 5 / 30

Russian Fascist Sets
Tongues Wagging; Asks
For New Revolution

(By Special Correspondent)
DAIREN, Apr. 30. (By Mail).—
A moderately stirring story also was
that of the visit of Mr. Anastase
Vonsiatsky, a Russian Fascist chief
from America who is sounding a
clarion call throughout the world
for the formation of the "Third
Internationale" with the consequent
dismemberment of the Soviet
Union.

"Third Internationale"
An impassioned appeal, urging
local Russian Fascists to become
soundly organized and at the same
time to wait for the decisive
moment when an attack on the
Soviet Union would prove success-
ful was launched by Mr. Anastase
Vonsiatsky, Russian Fascist leader
from America, at the Dairen
Russian Club.
Fascists only, combining the
finest traditions and characteristics
of Old Russia with a knowledge of

modern conditions at their best
could be responsible for wholesome
development for present day Russia,
the orator continued. The Com-
munists had been in power for 16
years and had done nothing except
to degrade, brutalize and pauperize
the people.
All previous attempts to remove
the scourge of Communism, he
went on, have failed largely be-
cause there was a sad lack of
cooperation by denationalized Rus-
sians against their common foe.
The coming movement must find
all, within and without their home-
land in perfect concert in the
struggle which would rid their
country of the red pollution which
was steadily devouring the land.
"We want all patriotic Russians
throughout the world to join a
Fascist organization so that when
the psychological moment arrives
you will be ready to complete your
assignments and bring peace and
prosperity once again to our great
land," he concluded.
Mr. Vonsiatsky, who has resided
in the United States for the past
10 years is married to a member
of a prominent American family
who is accompanying her husband
on his tour. He is now in the
north where he is addressing
Russian Fascists in Hsinking and
Harbin from where he is expected
to travel to Europe to continue his
work of organisation of the Russian
Fascists.

（特约通讯员报道）
大连，4月30日。（邮件送达）。—
另一个较为引人注目的故事是来自美国的俄罗斯法西斯首领阿纳斯塔斯·冯西亚茨基先生（Mr. Anastase Vonsiatsky）的访问，他正在全世界发出号角，呼吁组建“第三国际”，从而导致苏联的分裂。

“第三国际”
来自美国的俄罗斯法西斯领袖阿纳斯塔斯·冯西亚茨基先生在大连俄罗斯俱乐部发起了一项充满激情的呼吁，敦促当地的俄罗斯法西斯主义者进行健全的组织，同时等待攻击苏联能够取得成功的决定性时刻。
演讲者继续说道，只有法西斯主义者，将旧俄罗斯的最佳传统和特征与现代条件的最佳知识相结合，才能对当今俄罗斯的健康发展负责。共产党人已掌权16年，除了使人民堕落、野蛮化和贫困化之外，一事无成。
他接着说，此前消除共产主义祸害的所有尝试大多失败了，主要是因为去国籍化的俄罗斯人在对抗共同敌人时缺乏合作。即将到来的运动必须在国内外找到所有人完美协调一致，进行斗争，以摆脱正在 steadily devouring the land（稳步吞噬这片土地）的红色污染。
“我们希望全世界的爱国俄罗斯人都加入法西斯组织，以便当心理时刻到来时，你们准备好完成你们的任务，再次为我们伟大的土地带来和平与繁荣，”他总结道。
冯西亚茨基先生在过去10年里居住在美国，娶了一位显赫美国家庭的成员为妻，她正陪同丈夫进行此次巡回访问。他目前在北方，正在新京（Hsinking）和哈尔滨向俄罗斯法西斯主义者发表演讲，预计他将从那里前往欧洲，继续其组织俄罗斯法西斯主义者的工作。

The Star Daily News published the following article on

WHITE RUSSIANS ACTIVE IN SHANGHAI

There is a White Russian Fascist Party in
Manchuria, and the leader of the Party is one named
"Bushesky", who arrived in Shanghai the day before
yesterday on the "Tsingtao Maru". He is staying

the Communist Party. He came here to organize a
branch of the Fascist Party. Chinese and Japanese
will be urged to join the movement.

The above article refers to A.A. Vonsiatsky,
leader of the Russian Fascist Party, who recently
visited Shanghai.

Subject (in full) Lecture of A.A. Vonsiatsky on May 21, 1934 at the
Embassy Theatre, Bubbling Well Road.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by O.B.Km D.I. 26/5/34. D.I.

Between 7.30 p.m. and 8.30 p.m. on May 21st a lecture was
given by A.A. Vonsiatsky at the Embassy Theatre, Bubbling Well
Road, on the Russian Fascist Movement. About 800 Russians from
various Russian circles and political organisations attended.
Members of the local Russian Fascist Organisation with the Fascist
emblem and Russian scouts guarded the entrance and controlled
admission. In connection with the presence of the Russian boy-
scouts it is reported that Vonsiatsky presented a considerable
sum to the local Russian boy scouts organisation. Although the
meeting was due to start at 7 p.m. Vonsiatsky did not arrive
until 7.30 p.m.

In his lecture he pointed out the sources of the Fascist
movement all over the world and the importance of the organisation.
He hoped that Fascism would appeal to Russian Emigrants in
Shanghai. Vonsiatsky emphasised the necessity of organisation
in political movements and said that the best political Russian
organisation abroad is the All Russian Fascist Party. He then
described the tactics of the Russian Fascist Party. The main
object of the Fascist is the work among labourers and farmers
of the U.S.S.R. and the preparation of the overthrow of communist
rule. The success of this work depended on the selection of
slogans dealing with the division of the big collective farms
(Kolhozi) among individual small farmers, etc. The Civil War
ended, he said, because the White Army leader had no popular
slogans for the people. Later Vonsiatsky pointed out the
absolute necessity of unification of the Fascist Party in order
that a united Fascist front could be held against communism.
"During the last few years Fascism had had a great success and
"even our enemy could not deny it. The Fascist Party is at

主题（全称） A.A. 冯西亚茨基（A.A. Vonsiatsky）于1934年5月21日在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）大使剧院（Embassy Theatre）发表的演讲。
由 D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（D.S. Tcheremshansky）撰写，经 O.B.Km 转呈，D.I. 1934年5月26日。D.I.

5月21日晚7时30分至8时30分之间，A.A. 冯西亚茨基在静安寺路大使剧院就俄罗斯法西斯运动发表演讲。约有800名来自各个俄罗斯圈子及政治组织的俄国人出席。当地俄罗斯法西斯组织的成员佩戴法西斯徽章，并与俄罗斯童子军一起守卫入口并控制入场。鉴于俄罗斯童子军的出现，据报冯西亚茨基向当地俄罗斯童子军组织捐赠了一笔巨款。虽然会议定于晚7时开始，但冯西亚茨基直到晚7时30分才到达。

他在演讲中指出世界各地法西斯运动的源头以及该组织的重要性。他希望法西斯主义能吸引上海的俄罗斯侨民。冯西亚茨基强调了政治运动中组织的必要性，并称海外最好的俄罗斯政治组织是全俄法西斯党。随后他描述了全俄法西斯党的策略。法西斯分子的主要目标是在苏联的工人和农民中开展工作，并为推翻共产主义统治做准备。这项工作的成功取决于选择涉及将大型集体农庄（Kolhozi）分配给个体小农等内容的口号。他说，内战之所以结束，是因为白军领袖没有提出受民众欢迎的口号。后来，冯西亚茨基指出，为了建立统一的反共法西斯阵线，法西斯党绝对有必要实现统一。“在过去几年里，法西斯主义取得了巨大成功，”“甚至我们的敌人也无法否认这一点。法西斯党正在

answer the first call from Russia to assist our brothers in the
U.S.S.R. We are certain that former officers of the White Army,

Vonsiatsky also described conditions prevailing in the

“目前正准备培养一批骨干人员，他们必须随时准备响应来自俄罗斯的第一次号召，去援助我们在苏联的兄弟。我们确信，前白军军官、各类专家及科学工作者将加入我们的行列。”冯西亚茨基还描述了苏联 prevailing 的状况以及共产党政府与群众之间的斗争；军队中的叛乱；农民中的反布尔什维克运动等；以及国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）的恐怖统治。演讲于晚8时40分结束，冯西亚茨基获得了热烈的掌声。在场的大多数公众认为，冯西亚茨基作为一名演说家和宣传家并不成功，因为他的演讲内容均为众所周知的事实，且他并未清晰地描绘出法西斯主义的理想蓝图。

FASCISTI!

During the past 3 weeks and more Mr. A. Vonsiatsky
has been in the Far East (Shanghai-Harbin).
From a journal entitled the 'Fascist", which made its
first appearance in Shanghai only since the arrival of
A. Vonsiatsky, and which can be seen in the window of the
book-shop "Skifi", it can be learnt that A. Vonsiatsky
is the founder of "The Russian Fascist Party", United States
of America being his permanent residence.
On arrival at Yokohama, A. Vonsiatsky, had an interview
there with one V. Rodziaevsky, one of the leaders of the
party of Harbin Fascisti-Syndicalists. Later, on leaving
Shanghai for Harbin, A. Vonsiatsky established, according
to the interview granted by him to the Shanghai Zarya No.2680
and which has not been refuted up to date, an "All-Russian
Fascisti Party" with a Central Executive Committee. A.
Vonsiatsky was elected Chairman of the "All Russian Fascisti
Party" and V. Rodziaevsky General Secretary and Acting
Chairman of the same.
A. Vonsiatsky did not mention what he had achieved
in America, his permanent residence, but in the same
interview (Shanghai Zarya No.2680) A. Vonsiatsky spoke of
the expected formation of branches in South America and in
the Balkans, as well as in Shanghai.

法西斯主义者！

在过去的三周多时间里，A. 冯西亚茨基先生一直在远东（上海-哈尔滨）。
从一份名为《法西斯主义者》的期刊中可以得知，A. 冯西亚茨基是“俄罗斯法西斯党”的创始人，其永久居住地为美利坚合众国；该期刊自 A. 冯西亚茨基抵达后才在上海首次出现，可在“斯基菲”（Skifi）书店的橱窗中看到。
A. 冯西亚茨基抵达横滨后，在那里会见了 V. 罗佳耶夫斯基（V. Rodziaevsky），后者是哈尔滨法西斯-工团主义党派的领导人之一。后来，在离开上海前往哈尔滨时，根据他接受上海《霞报》（Zarya）第2680期采访所述（且至今未被驳斥），A. 冯西亚茨基成立了一个设有中央执行委员会的“全俄法西斯党”。A. 冯西亚茨基当选为“全俄法西斯党”主席，V. 罗佳耶夫斯基任总书记兼代主席。
A. 冯西亚茨基未提及他在其永久居住地美国取得的成就，但在同一篇采访（上海《霞报》第2680期）中，A. 冯西亚茨基谈到了预计将在南美洲、巴尔干地区以及上海设立分支机构。

The Council of the National Organization of

1) That the Council's suggestion, forwarded to
A. Vonsiatsky through the medium of the Secretary of the Party
Information Bureau, that he should hear a report on the
activities and achievements of the Party of N.O.R.F. since
the time of its institution in 1927, has not been replied
to up to this date.

2) That brief information received from Harbin
shows that A. Vonsiatsky has not succeeded in uniting
the Harbin Fascisti, but on the contrary caused dissension
which resulted in the formation of two groups in lieu of
the one which existed previously. v. Kodziaevsky's group
joined A. Vonsiatsky, whilst A. Pokrovsky's group
would not accept "the general line" of A. Vonsiatsky,
on which is built the formation of the "All-Russian Fascist
Party"

3) That A.Vonsiatsky introduced into the
programme of the "All-Russian Fascist Party" being
formed by him that which, he himself stated (Shanghai Zarya
No.2680) "had astounded the Harbin Fascisti and for a
time baffled them".

4) That in Shanghai A. Vonsiatsky has made
his selection of persons, to head the branch being formed
by him in Shanghai, who not only fail to enjoy the respect
of the wide circles of Russian emigrants, but some of whom
are even considered in the Russian community as politically

远东俄罗斯法西斯全国组织理事会审阅了上述信息并收到进一步情报后，决定向 N.O.R.F. 的法西斯主义者提出以下建议：-

1) 理事会通过党务局秘书向 A. 冯西亚茨基提出的建议，即让他听取自1927年成立以来 N.O.R.F. 党的活动及成就报告，截至目前尚未得到回复。

2) 从哈尔滨收到的简要信息显示，A. 冯西亚茨基未能团结哈尔滨的法西斯主义者，相反引起了分歧，导致形成了两个团体，取代了原先存在的一个团体。V. 科佳耶夫斯基（v. Kodziaevsky，原文如此，疑为Rodziaevsky之误）的团体加入了 A. 冯西亚茨基一方，而 A. 波克罗夫斯基的团体则不接受建立在“全俄法西斯党”基础之上的 A. 冯西亚茨基的“总路线”。

3) A. 冯西亚茨基在他正在组建的“全俄法西斯党”的计划中引入了他自己所说（上海《霞报》第2680期）“令哈尔滨法西斯主义者震惊并一度使他们困惑”的内容。

4) 在上海，A. 冯西亚茨基挑选了一些人来领导他正在上海组建的分支机构，这些人不仅未能赢得广大俄罗斯侨民阶层的尊重，其中一些人甚至在俄罗斯社区中被视为在政治

and socially disgraced and undesirable. In consequence
of the above said, and also taking into consideration the
information to hand, which cannot be published, for reasons
of Party status, the Council of the National Organization
of Russian Fascisti in accordance with paragraphs 4 and 6
of secret instructions of the High Council of the N.O.R.F.

I) To regard the actions of A. Vonsiatsky having for

the High Council of the N.O.R.F. in 1927 in ZAGREB, Jugo-Slavia.

3) To regard the general tendency and activities of
Vonsiatsky's Fascisti (The All-Russian Fascist Party) as
action opposed to the unity and co-operation of the
National groups amongst Emigrants.

4) To submit this declaration for approval of the
High Council of the N.O.R.F. and to distribute it for

和社会上蒙羞且不受欢迎的人。鉴于上述情况，并考虑到手头掌握的因党派地位原因无法公开的情报，远东俄罗斯法西斯全国组织理事会根据 N.O.R.F. 最高理事会秘密指令的第4和第6条，作出如下决定：-

4) 将此声明提交 N.O.R.F. 最高理事会批准，并将其分发以供远东法西斯主义者及所有民族侨民组织知晓。

Lecture by A. A. Vonsiatsky

Yesterday it was definitely decided, that
the lecture of the leader of the Russian Fascists,
A. A. Vonsiatsky, will be delivered tomorrow,
Monday, May 21, at 7 p.m. in the premises of the
"Embassy Theatre", Bubbling Well Road.

The programme of the lecture is:
1) The tactics of the United Fascist Front.
2) The crisis of the communist system.
3) The growth of the revolutionary movement in
the U.S.S.R. (anti-bolshevik).
4) The growth of Russian Fascism.

Admittance to the lecture is free but only
on production of invitation cards. The tickets
issued for admission to the proposed lecture in
the premises of the "Shanghai Mainichi" are
available for the lecture tomorrow.

May 23, 1934. Morning Translation

The Star Daily News published the following
article on May 21:-

THE S.M.C. AND THE VARIOUS DAILY NEWSPAPERS

Although the S.M.C. is the highest control
organ in the Settlement, it possesses administrative
rights only. The judicial rights are in the hands of
the Chinese Government. Therefore, all newspapers and
newspaper offices in the Settlement are subject to the
control of the Chinese publishing law, and the S.M.C.
has no right to interfere.
Formerly, the S.M.C. was of the opinion that
the Chinese newspapers exaggerated the news relating to
the S.M.C., such as the reports on the assault of Chinese
by foreign policemen, the factory questions, and torture
used in Police Stations.
Ten years ago, the S.M.C. tried to control
the Chinese newspapers and the regulations governing
newspapers were drafted, which invested the S.M.C. with
the right to interfere with newspaper managements, but
later, owing to the opposition of the Chinese, the efforts
of the Council were given up. Hence the Chinese news-
papers in the Settlement still enjoy absolute freedom.
The S.M.C. is again trying to place certain restrictions
on the Chir se newspapers, but, as there are no regulations
governing newspapers, the Council has expressed the hope
that the Chinese newspapers will accurately publish
reports relating to the S.M.C. The Chinese newspapers
will always report the hardships suffered by the Chinese
people.

The Star Daily News published the following
article on May 21:-

WHITE RUSSIANS ACTIVE IN SHANGHAI

There is a White Russian Fascist Party in
Manchuria, and the leader of the Party is one named
"Bushesky", who arrived in Shanghai the day before
yesterday on the "Tsingtao Maru". He is staying in
the Cathay Hotel and has held secret meetings with local
white Russians. He was a member of the royal family,
and was expelled from Russia by the Communist Party.
He came here to organize a branch of the Fascist Party.
Chinese and Japanese will be urged to join the movement.

Sin Wan Pao (Nanking Telegram) :

REACTIONARIES ESCORTED TO NANKING

The Bureau of Public Safety at Shanghai recently
arrested a number of reactionaries. The arrested persons
were escorted to Nanking on the morning of May 22, where
they are detained at the Gendarme Headquarters.

1934年5月23日。晨间译文

《星报》于5月21日刊登了以下文章：-

工部局与各日报

虽然工部局是租界内的最高管理机构，但其仅拥有行政权。司法权掌握在中国政府手中。因此，租界内所有报纸及报馆均受中国出版法的管辖，工部局无权干涉。
此前，工部局认为中文报纸夸大了有关工部局的新闻，例如关于外籍巡捕殴打华人、工厂问题以及警察局内使用酷刑的报道。
十年前，工部局曾试图管制中文报纸，并起草了相关报刊条例，赋予工部局干预报业管理的权力，但后来由于华人的反对，工部局的努力被放弃。因此，租界内的中文报纸仍然享有绝对的自由。工部局再次试图对中文报纸施加某些限制，但由于没有管理报纸的法规，工部局表示希望中文报纸能准确刊登有关工部局的报道。中文报纸将始终报道中国人民所遭受的苦难。

《星报》于5月21日刊登了以下文章：-

白俄在上海的活动

满洲有一个白俄法西斯党，该党领袖名为“布什斯基”(Bushesky)，他于前天乘坐“青岛丸”号抵达上海。他住在华懋饭店，并与当地的白俄举行了秘密会议。他是皇室成员，被共产党驱逐出俄国。他来此是为了组建法西斯党的一个分支。将敦促中国人和日本人加入该运动。

《新晚报》（南京电）：

反动分子被押送南京

上海市公安局最近逮捕了一批反动分子。被捕人员于5月22日上午被押送至南京，目前拘禁于宪兵司令部。

"Slovo" of May 11, 1934.    No.
The return of A.A. Vonsiatsky. He is quite
satisfied with the results of his trip
A. A. Vonsiatsky together with his wife and D.I.
Kunle, returned to Shanghai from Harbin at 3 p.m.
yesterday on board the "Tsingtao Maru" after three weeks
absence.
A. V. Vonsiatsky, during the course of an interview
with our reporter, stated in detail his impressions of
Harbin, the activity of the Russian Fascist Party there
and about the unification of all Fascist bodies into one
through the organization of an All-Russian Fascist Party.
On their departure from Harbin, A. A. Vonsiatsky
and D.I. Kunle, recently elected Chief of Staff of the
All-Russian Fascist Party, made a declaration to the
effect that the activities of the Party will be directed
by the Central Executive Committee in Harbin. A. A.
Vonsiatsky was elected Chairman of the Executive Committee,
while K. V. Rodzaevsky was appointed Assistant Chairman
and General Secretary. Continuing A. A. Vonsiatsky and
D. I. Kunle outlined the general line of work, the
directorship and tactics already decided upon. The new
campaign will mean that the efforts of the Russian Fascists
will be concentrated in struggles against communism and will
take new forms, i.e. to induce the peasant and labourer
masses to join the struggle. Regarding the position of the
All-Russian Fascist Party towards the Jewish question, A.A.
Vonsiatsky remarked:- "I have to state that this question
was discussed on numerous occasions at meetings of our
recently organized Central Executive Committee of the All-
Russian Fascist Party. Concerning this the Party decided
to take a firm stand in following:- the position of the All-
Russian Fascist Party towards the Jewry corresponds to the
attitude taken by the Jewry towards the Russian Fascist
Movement." A.A. Vonsiatsky is expected to stay in

A. V. 冯西亚茨基在接受本报记者采访时，详细陈述了他对哈尔滨的印象、俄罗斯法西斯党在当地的活动，以及通过组建全俄法西斯党将所有法西斯团体统一为一个整体的情况。
在离开哈尔滨之际，A. A. 冯西亚茨基与新近当选为全俄法西斯党参谋长的 D.I. 昆勒发表声明称，该党的活动将由位于哈尔滨的中央执行委员会指导。A. A. 冯西亚茨基当选为执行委员会主席，而 K. V. 罗扎耶夫斯基 (Rodzaevsky) 被任命为副主席兼总书记。接着，A. A. 冯西亚茨基和 D. I. 昆勒概述了已确定的总体工作方针、领导层及策略。新的运动意味着俄罗斯法西斯分子的努力将集中于反共斗争，并将采取新的形式，即诱导农民和劳工大众加入斗争。关于全俄法西斯党在犹太问题上的立场，A.A. 冯西亚茨基 remarked:- “我必须指出，在我们新近组建的全俄法西斯党中央执行委员会的会议上，这一问题曾被多次讨论。对此，本党决定采取如下坚定立场：全俄法西斯党对犹太人的态度，取决于犹太人对俄罗斯法西斯运动的态度。” 预计 A.A. 冯西亚茨基将停留于

EXTRACT OF NEWSPAPER TRANSLATION OF MAY 11, 1934.

NIPPO

Vonsiatsky ACTIVITIES OF RUSSIAN FASCIST: ARRIVAL OF
MR. BONSASKY

Yesterday afternoon Mr.A. Bonsasky (?),
head of the Russian fascists in Manchukuo, arrived in
Shanghai on the s.s. Tsingtao Maru. He proceeded to
the Cathay Hotel where he held a conference with a
number of important white Russians in Shanghai. He
is accompanied by his wife and his secretary named
Ghunt, age 28, who is a member of a noble family. The
object of his visit to Shanghai is to unite all white
Russians in Shanghai to co-operate with the Russians in
Harbin.

In a press interview Mr. Bonsasky
stated that several hundred thousand Russians have resided
in foreign countries since the Bolshevik revolution, and
now the time has come for the organization of the Russian
fascist party with a view to establishing a new White
Russian colony on the same lines as Manchukuo. He also
stated that about 20000 Russians in Harbin have also
joined the fascist party and it was hoped that all the
Russians in China would join, and afterwards, he intended
to continue the movement in Japan.

a.c. S.B.
Information 18/5

Juli

《尼波报》(NIPPO)

俄罗斯法西斯分子冯西亚茨基的活动：
邦萨斯基先生抵达

昨日下午，满洲国俄罗斯法西斯头目 A. 邦萨斯基 (Bonsasky) (?) 先生乘坐“青岛丸”号轮船抵达上海。他前往华懋饭店，并与在上海的多位重要白俄人士举行了会议。随同前来的有他的妻子及其秘书格恩特 (Ghunt)，后者28岁，出身贵族家庭。他访问上海的目的是联合在上海的所有白俄，与哈尔滨的俄国人合作。

在接受媒体采访时，邦萨斯基先生表示，自布尔什维克革命以来，已有数十万俄国人居住在国外，现在是组织俄罗斯法西斯党的时候了，旨在按照满洲国的模式建立一个新的白俄殖民地。他还表示，哈尔滨约有20,000名俄国人已加入法西斯党，并希望所有在华俄人都能加入，此后，他打算在日本继续开展该运动。
